crabhammer.name: Crabhammer
crabhammer.description: Crabhammer deals damage and has an increased critical hit ratio.

explosion.name: Explosion
explosion.description: Explosion inflicts damage, and causes the user to faint.

fury-swipes.name: Fury Swipes
fury-swipes.description: Fury Swipes inflicts damage, hitting the target 2-5 times per use. There is a 37.5% chance that it will hit 2 times, a 37.5% chance that it will hit 3 times, a 12.5% chance that it will hit 4 times, and a 12.5% chance that it will hit 5 times. Although only the first strike can be a critical hit, each successive one will deal the same amount of damage.

bonemerang.name: Bonemerang
bonemerang.description: Bonemerang inflicts damage, hitting the target twice per use. Although only the first strike can be a critical hit, the second one will deal the same amount of damage.

rest.name: Rest
rest.description: Rest causes the user to fall Sleep, restoring its HP to its maximum amount. The user is unable to use moves while asleep for 2 turns after the turn when Rest is used.

sharpen.name: Sharpen
sharpen.description: Sharpen increases the user's Attack stat by one stage.

super-fang.name: Super Fang
super-fang.description: Super Fang deals damage equal to 50% of the target's current HP, rounded down. It always deals at least 1 HP of damage.

hyper-fang.name: Hyper Fang
hyper-fang.description: Hyper Fang deals damage and has a 10% chance of causing the target to flinch.

rock-slide.name: Rock Slide
rock-slide.description: Rock Slide deals damage with no additional effect.

slash.name: Slash
slash.description: Slash deals damage and has an increased critical hit ratio. If used by a Pokémon with Sharpness, its power is increased by 50%.

tri-attack.name: Tri Attack
tri-attack.description: Tri Attack inflicts damage and has no secondary effect.

conversion.name: Conversion
conversion.description: Conversion changes the user's type to the target's current type(s). The user's original type(s) are restored once it is switched out, faints, or the current battle ends. This move can be used repeatedly even if the user and target already have the same type(s).

substitute.name: Substitute
substitute.description: By giving up 25% of its maximum HP (rounded down), the user creates a . The substitute's HP is equal to the amount lost to create it (except in Generation I, where it is 1 HP higher). The move fails if the user already has a substitute.

triple-kick.name: Triple Kick
triple-kick.description: Triple Kick inflicts damage, hitting the target up to three times per use. Its base power is 10.

sketch.name: Sketch
sketch.description: Sketch allows the user to learn the target's last move permanently, replacing Sketch in the process.

thief.name: Thief
thief.description: Thief inflicts damage and has a 99.6% chance to steal the target's held item if it has one, though only if the user does not have one. Thief cannot steal an item if it hits a Pokémon's . Held Mail cannot be stolen.

spider-web.name: Spider Web
spider-web.description: Spider Web prevents the target from switching out or fleeing (including via Teleport). It bypasses accuracy checks to always hit, unless the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move such as Dig or Fly. Spider Web's effect only applies as long as the Pokémon that used it remains in battle.

mind-reader.name: Mind Reader
mind-reader.description: After the user has used Mind Reader and until its effect ends (see table below), any accuracy check it makes against the same target will succeed; this means moves will not miss, even if the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move such as Dig or Fly. Although this effect means moves will not "miss", they can still fail for other reasons (such as being Protected, or Fake Out being used outside the first turn) or be redirected by and . The damaging turn of Future Sight and Doom Desire counts as an accuracy check.

flame-wheel.name: Flame Wheel
flame-wheel.description: Flame Wheel will thaw out the user if it is Freeze, and then inflict damage on the target. Flame Wheel also has a 10% chance of burning the target.

flail.name: Flail
flail.description: Flail inflicts damage and has no additional effect. Its power is based on the user's current HP as a percentage of its maximum HP, which is higher the lower the user's HP is.

curse.name: Curse
curse.description: In all generations, Curse acts differently depending on whether the user has the Ghost type or not.

aeroblast.name: Aeroblast
aeroblast.description: Aeroblast deals damage and has an increased critical hit ratio.

snore.name: Snore
snore.description: Snore can only be used if the user is currently Sleep; otherwise, it will fail. Snore inflicts damage and has a 30% chance of causing the target to flinch.

conversion-2.name: Conversion 2
conversion-2.description: Conversion 2 will randomly change the user's type to any type that either resists or is immune to the type of the last move which affected the user.

cotton-spore.name: Cotton Spore
cotton-spore.description: Cotton Spore lowers the target's Speed stat by two stages.

nightmare.name: Nightmare
nightmare.description: If the target is asleep, Nightmare afflicts the target with a status that causes it to take damage equal to one quarter of its maximum HP each turn. Nightmare inflicts damage after the afflicted Pokémon or its Trainer takes an action, unless its opponent faints (in which case Nightmare does not damage it that turn). If the Pokémon wakes up, the effect of Nightmare ends and does not reoccur if put back to sleep.

reversal.name: Reversal
reversal.description: Reversal inflicts damage and has no additional effect. Its power is based on the user's current HP as a percentage of its maximum HP, which is higher the lower the user's HP is.

spite.name: Spite
spite.description: damage?}} Spite decreases the PP of the last move the target used. Spite fails if that move has no PP remaining. It also fails if the target has not used a move since it was last sent out, or if the target's last used move was Struggle.

struggle.name: Struggle
struggle.description: Struggle inflicts damage, and the user takes recoil damage. Struggle is capable of striking a critical hit. In Double Battles, its target is a randomly selected opponent.

powder-snow.name: Powder Snow
powder-snow.description: Powder Snow inflicts damage and has a 10% chance of Freeze the target.

protect.name: Protect
protect.description: Protect protects the user from all effects of moves that target it during the turn it is used, including damage. This does not include damage at the end of a turn such as from weather or a status condition.

mach-punch.name: Mach Punch
mach-punch.description: Mach Punch inflicts damage. It has a priority of +1, so it is used before all moves that do not have increased priority.

feint-attack.name: Feint Attack
feint-attack.description: Feint Attack inflicts damage and bypasses accuracy checks to always hit, unless the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move such as Dig or Fly.

belly-drum.name: Belly Drum
belly-drum.description: Belly Drum deducts half of the user's maximum HP (rounded down) from its current HP and, in return, it maximizes the user's Attack stat by raising it to +6 stages, even if the user's temporary Attack bonus stages were below 0 prior to using Belly Drum.

sludge-bomb.name: Sludge Bomb
sludge-bomb.description: Sludge Bomb inflicts damage and has a 30% chance of Poison the target. It has no effect on targets with Bulletproof.

scary-face.name: Scary Face
scary-face.description: Scary Face lowers the target's Speed stat by two stages. Scary Face's accuracy is 90%.

sweet-kiss.name: Sweet Kiss
sweet-kiss.description: Sweet Kiss causes the target to become Confusion. Sweet Kiss cannot affect targets with Own Tempo as their Ability.

octazooka.name: Octazooka
octazooka.description: Octazooka inflicts damage and has a 50% chance to lower the target's accuracy by one stage. Pokémon with the Bulletproof Ability are immune to Octazooka.

spikes.name: Spikes
spikes.description: Spikes sets an entry hazard around the enemy team's field. Pokémon who switch into the spike-ridden field take 12.5% of their maximum HP in damage (rounded down). Flying Pokémon are immune to this damage. The move Rapid Spin removes Spikes around the user.

mud-slap.name: Mud-Slap
mud-slap.description: Mud-Slap inflicts damage and has a 99.6% chance of lowering the target's accuracy stat by one stage.

zap-cannon.name: Zap Cannon
zap-cannon.description: Zap Cannon inflicts damage and has a 255/256 (~99.6%) chance of paralyzing the target.

foresight.name: Foresight
foresight.description: When Foresight is used, if the user's accuracy stat stage is less than the target's evasion stat stage, both stat stages will be treated as zero during accuracy checks against the target. This effect remains until the target switches out, but the effect may be passed via Baton Pass.

destiny-bond.name: Destiny Bond
destiny-bond.description: When Destiny Bond is used, the user gains the Destiny Bound status. Until the user moves again, if the user faints as the direct result of an attack, the attacking Pokémon also faints. If the user takes another turn (including "inactive" turns such as those spent sleeping or flinching), the effect disappears.

detect.name: Detect
detect.description: Detect protects the user from all effects of moves that target it during the turn it is used, including damage. This does not include damage at the end of a turn such as from weather or a status condition.

icy-wind.name: Icy Wind
icy-wind.description: Icy Wind inflicts damage and has a 255/256 (~99.6%) chance of lowering the target's Speed stat by one stage.

perish-song.name: Perish Song
perish-song.description: All Pokémon on the field when Perish Song is used gain a perish count, except Pokémon with the Ability Soundproof and Pokémon that already have a perish count. Starting at 4 on the turn Perish Song is used, the perish count decreases by 1 at the end of each turn (including the turn Perish Song was used). When a Pokémon's perish count reaches 0, it faints.

outrage.name: Outrage
outrage.description: Outrage deals damage and gives the user the Rampaging status. Under the Rampaging status, the user continues using Outrage for 2-3 turns and is unable to take any other actions. Afterwards, the Rampaging status is lifted and the user becomes confusion.

endure.name: Endure
endure.description: For the rest of the turn, Endure allows the user to survive any attack that would cause it to faint, leaving the user with 1 HP instead. Endure can be used by Pokémon with only 1 HP, and can protect the user from fainting from multiple attacks in one turn.

lock-on.name: Lock-On
lock-on.description: After the user has used Lock-On and until its effect ends (see table below), any accuracy check it makes against the same target will succeed; this means moves will not miss, even if the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move such as Dig or Fly. Although this effect means moves will not "miss", they can still fail for other reasons (such as being Protected, or Fake Out being used outside the first turn) or be redirected by and . The damaging turn of Future Sight and Doom Desire counts as an accuracy check.

giga-drain.name: Giga Drain
giga-drain.description: Giga Drain inflicts damage, and up to 50% of the damage dealt to the target is restored to the user as HP (but not less than 1 HP), restoring up to the Pokémon's maximum HP. Giga Drain has 60 base power and 5 PP.

rollout.name: Rollout
rollout.description: Rollout inflicts damage over five turns, doubling in power for each consecutive hit; the power will reset after five turns or if Rollout is interrupted. It is a . Rollout's power is doubled in addition if the user had previously used Defense Curl.

milk-drink.name: Milk Drink
milk-drink.description: Milk Drink restores up to 50% of the user's maximum HP, rounded down.

false-swipe.name: False Swipe
false-swipe.description: False Swipe inflicts damage, but will leave the target with 1 HP if it would otherwise cause it to faint. If the target has 1 HP remaining, False Swipe will hit and leave the target at 1 HP.

spark.name: Spark
spark.description: Spark inflicts damage and has a 30% chance of Paralyze the target.

fury-cutter.name: Fury Cutter
fury-cutter.description: Fury Cutter starts with a base power of 10. Every time Fury Cutter hits the power will double, even if other moves are used in between. The power may double up to a maximum of 160 (which could take minimum 5 turns). If the user misses a move, the user hits itself in confusion, the user is switched out, or the player uses an item, the power will reset to normal.

charm.name: Charm
charm.description: Charm is a Normal move. It lowers the Attack stat of the target by two stages.

swagger.name: Swagger
swagger.description: Swagger raises the target's Attack stat by two stages and confusion it. Even if the target is already confused, or cannot become confused due to an effect such as Safeguard, its Attack will still be raised.

attract.name: Attract
attract.description: The target becomes infatuated with the user if they have opposite genders. Attract works regardless of type immunity. Unlike most status moves, Attract is able to bypass a .

steel-wing.name: Steel Wing
steel-wing.description: Steel Wing inflicts damage and has a 10% chance of raising the user's Defense by one stage.

mean-look.name: Mean Look
mean-look.description: Mean Look gives the target the Can't Escape status meaning that it cannot flee or switch out as long as the user is in battle. It bypasses accuracy checks to always hit, unless the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move such as Dig or Fly. The effect only applies as long as the Pokémon that used it remains in battle.

heal-bell.name: Heal Bell
heal-bell.description: Heal Bell cures the user, all Pokémon in the user's party, and the user's allies, of all status conditions (sleep, poison, paralysis, freeze, and burn). Heal Bell affects Pokémon even if they are behind a .

return.name: Return
return.description: Return inflicts damage and has no secondary effect. The base power of Return is dependent on the friendship of the user. The greater the user's friendship, the greater the base power.

safeguard.name: Safeguard
safeguard.description: Safeguard prevents the user and its allies from being inflicted with conditions and confusion for five turns. Existing status conditions are not cured by Safeguard and have their effects as normal.

present.name: Present
present.description: Present can either deal damage against the target or heal it for 1/4 of its maximum HP. If Present deals damage, then the base power of Present is chosen at random from 40, 80, or 120.

frustration.name: Frustration
frustration.description: Frustration inflicts damage and has no secondary effect. The base power of Frustration is dependent on the user's friendship. The lower the user's friendship is, the greater the base power of Frustration.

pain-split.name: Pain Split
pain-split.description: Pain Split adds the current HP of the user and target Pokémon. It then divides this value by two, rounds down if necessary, and increases or decreases the HP of each Pokémon to become equal to the result (limited by each Pokémon's maximum HP). This setting of HP is not subject to effects such as Counter or Bide. Pain Split does not employ , so it can also affect Ghost Pokémon.

sleep-talk.name: Sleep Talk
sleep-talk.description: If the user is currently Sleep, then it will automatically use a randomly selected move from its moveset. Sleep Talk will not select itself or any of the unselectable moves listed below. Sleep Talk will fail if the user is not asleep, or if the user does not know any moves other than Sleep Talk or the unselectable moves.

magnitude.name: Magnitude
magnitude.description: Magnitude's power varies based on a randomly selected "magnitude" value ranging from 4 to 10, with 4 having the least power and 10 having the greatest.

dynamic-punch.name: Dynamic Punch
dynamic-punch.description: Dynamic Punch deals damage and Confusions the target.

sacred-fire.name: Sacred Fire
sacred-fire.description: Sacred Fire inflicts damage, with a 50% chance of burning the target. If the user is Freeze, using Sacred Fire will thaw out the user and deal damage to the target in the same turn.

megahorn.name: Megahorn
megahorn.description: Megahorn deals damage and has no secondary effect.

bone-rush.name: Bone Rush
bone-rush.description: Bone Rush inflicts damage, hitting the target 2-5 times per use. There is a 37.5% chance that it will hit 2 times, a 37.5% chance that it will hit 3 times, a 12.5% chance that it will hit 4 times, and a 12.5% chance that it will hit 5 times. Each strike made has an equal chance to be a critical hit.

dragon-breath.name: Dragon Breath
dragon-breath.description: Dragon Breath inflicts damage and has a 30% chance of Paralysis the target.

encore.name: Encore
encore.description: Encore temporarily prevents the target from using any move except the last used move.

rapid-spin.name: Rapid Spin
rapid-spin.description: Rapid Spin inflicts damage and then removes the effects of any binding moves and Leech Seed from the user, as well as entry hazards from the user's side of the field.

pursuit.name: Pursuit
pursuit.description: Pursuit inflicts damage with a power of 40. If the target Pokémon is switched out on the turn Pursuit is used, Pursuit's power doubles, and it will immediately be used before it is switched out (including an accuracy check). This does not apply if used on an ally switching out, on a fleeing Pokémon, on a Pokémon using Teleport or Baton Pass, or on a Pokémon being forced to switch out.

moonlight.name: Moonlight
moonlight.description: Moonlight restores the user's current HP based on the weather and time of day. In the morning and daytime, during no weather, it restores ¼ total HP, during harsh sunlight it restores ½ total HP, and during other weather it restores ⅛ total HP, rounded down. Except in link battles, the move restores twice as much HP at night.

sweet-scent.name: Sweet Scent
sweet-scent.description: Sweet Scent lowers the evasion of all adjacent opponents by one stage.

baton-pass.name: Baton Pass
baton-pass.description: Baton Pass switches out the user and passes several effects to the Pokémon switched in its place.

vital-throw.name: Vital Throw
vital-throw.description: Vital Throw deals damage and is a decreased priority move, causing the user to attack after other Pokémon that are using ordinary priority moves. However, it will strike before Pokémon using other decreased priority moves such as Focus Punch and Avalanche. Vital Throw bypasses accuracy checks to always hit, unless the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move such as Dig or Fly.

iron-tail.name: Iron Tail
iron-tail.description: Iron Tail inflicts damage and has a 30% chance of lowering the target's Defense stat by one stage.

metal-claw.name: Metal Claw
metal-claw.description: Metal Claw deals damage and has a 10% chance of raising the user's Attack stat by one stage.

synthesis.name: Synthesis
synthesis.description: Synthesis restores the user's current HP based on the weather and time of day. In morning and night, during no weather it restores ¼ total HP, during harsh sunlight it restores ½ total HP, and during other weather it restores ⅛ total HP, rounded down. Except in link battles, the move restores twice as much HP during the daytime.

morning-sun.name: Morning Sun
morning-sun.description: Morning Sun restores the user's current HP based on the weather and time of day. In day and at night, during no weather it restores ¼ total HP, during harsh sunlight it restores ½ total HP, and during other weather it restores ⅛ total HP, rounded down. Except in link battles, the move restores twice as much HP in the morning.

cross-chop.name: Cross Chop
cross-chop.description: Cross Chop deals damage and has an increased critical hit ratio.

twister.name: Twister
twister.description: Twister inflicts damage and has a 20% chance of causing each target to flinch.

rain-dance.name: Rain Dance
rain-dance.description: When this move is used, a rainfall will start on the field which will last for five turns. This clears any other weather and it's possible to use it even if it is already raining.

crunch.name: Crunch
crunch.description: Crunch does damage and has a 20% chance of lowering the target's Special Defense stat by one stage.

mirror-coat.name: Mirror Coat
mirror-coat.description: If the last amount of damage done to the user before the use of Mirror Coat is greater than 0 and was dealt by a special move, Mirror Coat will do twice as much damage as taken by that attack to the opponent. If the opponent uses a physical move or does not attack at all, Mirror Coat fails. Dark Pokémon are immune to Mirror Coat, but otherwise, Mirror Coat's type has no effect on the damage done to the target.

sunny-day.name: Sunny Day
sunny-day.description: When this move is used, the sunlight will brighten the field. This effect will last for 5 turns, during which Pokémon cannot be freeze (though this does not affect when an already-frozen Pokémon thaws). This clears any other type of weather and is usable even when it's already sunny.

ancient-power.name: Ancient Power
ancient-power.description: Ancient Power inflicts damage and has a 10% chance of raising the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by one stage each.

extreme-speed.name: Extreme Speed
extreme-speed.description: ExtremeSpeed inflicts damage. It has a priority of +1, so is used before all moves that do not have increased priority.

rock-smash.name: Rock Smash
rock-smash.description: The move inflicts damage and has a 50% chance of lowering the target's Defense stat by one stage.

beat-up.name: Beat Up
beat-up.description: Beat Up inflicts damage on the target from the user and from each conscious Pokémon in the user's party that does not have a non-volatile status.

psych-up.name: Psych Up
psych-up.description: Psych Up resets the user's stat changes and copies all of the target's stat stages onto the user (Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, Speed, accuracy, and evasion). Psych Up will fail if all of the target's stat stages are 0.

whirlpool.name: Whirlpool
whirlpool.description: Whirlpool inflicts damage and then traps the target for a number of turns, inflicting damage at the end of each turn as well, as seen in the table below.

stockpile.name: Stockpile
stockpile.description: Stockpile stores up energy for the user and has no secondary effect. The maximum number of stockpiles the user can hold is three. If used after the third count, it will fail.

spit-up.name: Spit Up
spit-up.description: This move will fail if the user has not used Stockpile. If Spit Up is used after stockpiling, Spit Up inflicts damage to the target and has no secondary effect. Its power is 100, and its damage is multiplied by the number of times Stockpile was used.

future-sight.name: Future Sight
future-sight.description: On the turn Future Sight is selected, this attack will do nothing other than say that the user has foreseen an attack. Two turns later, Future Sight will do damage against the target (this happens after both Pokémon have attacked).

shadow-ball.name: Shadow Ball
shadow-ball.description: Shadow Ball deals damage and has a 20% chance of lowering the target's Special Defense by one stage, even in Generations II and III where it was a physical move.

uproar.name: Uproar
uproar.description: Uproar deals damage and gives the user the Uproar status. This causes the user to use Uproar for several turns, and during this time, no Pokémon are able to fall sleep (with some exceptions, depending on the game). Afterwards the Uproar status is lifted and the user will calm down.

fake-out.name: Fake Out
fake-out.description: Fake Out inflicts damage and always makes the target flinch, unless it has the Ability Inner Focus or Shield Dust. It has a priority of +1, so is used before all moves that do not have increased priority.

heat-wave.name: Heat Wave
heat-wave.description: Heat Wave inflicts damage and has a 10% chance of burn the target.

hail.name: Hail
hail.description: When Hail is used, a will begin on the field. This effect will last for 5 turns. This clears any other type of weather.

torment.name: Torment
torment.description: Torment prevents the target from using the same move twice in a row. The effect lasts until the target is switched out. If a Pokémon has selected the move it used last turn and becomes affected with Torment, it may still use the move this turn (even if it moves after the user of Torment).

flatter.name: Flatter
flatter.description: Flatter raises the target's Special Attack stat by one stage and confusion it. Even if the target is already confused, or cannot become confused due to Safeguard or Own Tempo, its Special Attack will still be raised. Even if the target's Special Attack is already at +6 stages, it will still become confused. Even if the target has Contrary and its Special Attack is already at -6 stages, it will still become confused.

swallow.name: Swallow
swallow.description: This move will fail if the user has not used Stockpile. If Swallow is used after stockpiling, it recovers the user's HP depending on the number of times Stockpile was used: * 1× → 25% of the user's maximum HP * 2× → 50% of the user's maximum HP * 3× → all of the user's maximum HP After Swallow is used, the stockpile count will be reset to 0.

memento.name: Memento
memento.description: Memento causes the user to faint and in return lowers the Attack and Special Attack stat of the target by two stages each.

smelling-salts.name: Smelling Salts
smelling-salts.description: Smelling Salts deals damage. Its power will double against a Paralysis target, but it will also cure the target of paralysis. If the target has a , it only does normal damage (paralysis cannot be cured and power is not doubled).

facade.name: Facade
facade.description: Facade inflicts damage. Its base power doubles from 70 to 140 if the user is poisoned, Paralysis, or burned.

will-o-wisp.name: Will-O-Wisp
will-o-wisp.description: Will-O-Wisp inflicts a burn on the target. It has no effect on Fire Pokémon and cannot affect targets with Water Veil as their Ability.

helping-hand.name: Helping Hand
helping-hand.description: Helping Hand is an increased priority move that will increase the damage done by the user's ally this turn by 50%.

follow-me.name: Follow Me
follow-me.description: Follow Me makes the user the center of attention, forcing opposing Pokémon to use their moves on the user rather than the intended target (even if it was a friendly target, unless it is a move that cannot target an opponent such as Acupressure or Helping Hand) for the rest of the turn. If a move cannot target the center of attention, it will be used on its intended target. It does not affect allies.

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.description: Taunt makes the afflicted Pokémon unable to use status moves. The effect wears off if the subject is switched out. Unlike most status moves, Taunt will affect a target with a .

nature-power.name: Nature Power
nature-power.description: Nature Power becomes a different move depending on the environment that the battle is being conducted in.

trick.name: Trick
trick.description: The user switches held items with the target. If only one of them is holding an item, the item is moved to the other.

role-play.name: Role Play
role-play.description: Role Play replaces the user's Ability with the target's Ability.

charge.name: Charge
charge.description: If the user's next move is Electric, it will deal twice the usual amount of damage. If its next move is not Electric-type or is a non-damaging move, the effect of Charge wears off without being used.

assist.name: Assist
assist.description: The Assist user executes a move that is randomly selected from all the eligible moves known by other Pokémon in the same party. If the same move is known by multiple Pokémon, each of them counts and therefore the move is more likely to be called.

ingrain.name: Ingrain
ingrain.description: Ingrain causes the user to gain the Ingrained status, this restores 1/16th of its maximum HP at the end of every turn, but also prevents it from escaping or switching out. If a Pokémon with the Ingrained status is holding a Big Root, the amount of HP restored is increased by 30%.

magic-coat.name: Magic Coat
magic-coat.description: also apply to Magic Coat? What is the precedence for other like Volt Absorb?}} For the remainder of the turn, Magic Coat reflects certain status moves back at the attacker. Refer below for the .

wish.name: Wish
wish.description: The turn Wish is used, the user will make a wish. At the end of the next turn, the Pokémon in the user's current position will be healed by a certain amount of HP.

brick-break.name: Brick Break
brick-break.description: Brick Break removes Light Screen and Reflect from the opponent's side of the field (even if it targets an ally), then inflicts damage. It will remove Light Screen and Reflect even if the target is immune to Brick Break (i.e. a Ghost Pokémon). It will not remove Light Screen or Reflect if Brick Break misses or the target is from Brick Break.

recycle.name: Recycle
recycle.description: Recycle allows the user to recover a held item (such as a Berry) that has been previously consumed in battle.

superpower.name: Superpower
superpower.description: Superpower inflicts damage, then lowers the user's Attack and Defense stats by one stage each.

yawn.name: Yawn
yawn.description: Yawn makes the target drowsy. At the end of the next turn, the drowsy Pokémon will fall sleep, unless it is already afflicted by a non-volatile status condition. If a drowsy Pokémon switches out, it loses its drowsiness. Drowsiness cannot be passed by Baton Pass.

revenge.name: Revenge
revenge.description: Revenge deals damage and is a decreased priority move, causing the user to attack after other Pokémon that are using ordinary priority moves. If the target had already damaged the user in the same turn, Revenge's power is doubled to 120.

knock-off.name: Knock Off
knock-off.description: Knock Off inflicts damage and knocks off the target's held item if it has one.

eruption.name: Eruption
eruption.description: Eruption deals damage. It has 150 base power at maximum HP, but its base power decreases linearly with the user's remaining HP.

imprison.name: Imprison
imprison.description: Imprison causes user to gain the Sealing Off status, opponents cannot use any move that are also known by the user. This includes opponents switched in after the move was used, and non-adjacent opponents in Triple Battles.

skill-swap.name: Skill Swap
skill-swap.description: Skill Swap exchanges the Abilities of the user and the target. If a Pokémon affected by Skill Swap is switched out, it regains its original Ability.

endeavor.name: Endeavor
endeavor.description: Endeavor deals damage to the target equal to the target's remaining HP minus the user's remaining HP, making them both equal. It will deduct the difference from the target's HP. This move does nothing if the target's HP is the same as or lower than the user's. Type immunity is not ignored, so Endeavor does not usually affect Ghost Pokémon regardless of HP.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Refresh cures the user of burns, poison, or paralysis. It cannot cure freeze or sleep, so Refresh will fail if it is called by Sleep Talk.

focus-punch.name: Focus Punch
focus-punch.description: Focus Punch deals damage. It has a priority of -3. The move fails if the user has already taken damage from a move in the same turn.

dive.name: Dive
dive.description: The user gains the status on the turn this move is used, then attacks on the following turn.

arm-thrust.name: Arm Thrust
arm-thrust.description: Arm Thrust inflicts damage, hitting the target 2-5 times per use. There is a 37.5% chance that it will hit 2 times, a 37.5% chance that it will hit 3 times, a 12.5% chance that it will hit 4 times, and a 12.5% chance that it will hit 5 times. Each strike made has an equal chance to be a critical hit.

grudge.name: Grudge
grudge.description: When Grudge is used, if the user faints as the direct result of an attack, the move which causes the user to faint will lose all of its PP. This move's effect only works if the user faints before making another action. Grudge does not activate for Struggle or for damage that occurs at the end of the turn, including damage from Leech Seed, poison, burn, , , and Future Sight.

luster-purge.name: Luster Purge
luster-purge.description: Luster Purge inflicts damage and has a 50% chance of lowering the target's Special Defense stat by one stage.

secret-power.name: Secret Power
secret-power.description: Secret Power inflicts damage and has a 30% chance of causing a secondary effect. The effect and animation are determined by the current environment. The effect and animation caused by each environment change between games, as do the environments recognized.

camouflage.name: Camouflage
camouflage.description: Camouflage changes the Pokémon's type to a type corresponding to the battlefield terrain. The type caused by each environment changes between games, as do the environments recognized.

snatch.name: Snatch
snatch.description: Snatch is an increased priority move. After being used, if another Pokémon (including an ally) attempts to use a beneficial status move, the user of Snatch steals the move and uses the move itself instead of the move's original user.

mist-ball.name: Mist Ball
mist-ball.description: Mist Ball inflicts damage and has a 50% chance of lowering the target's Special Attack stat by one stage. It does not affect targets with Bulletproof.

feather-dance.name: Feather Dance
feather-dance.description: Feather Dance lowers the target's Attack stat by two stages.

tail-glow.name: Tail Glow
tail-glow.description: Tail Glow increases the user's Special Attack by two stages.

teeter-dance.name: Teeter Dance
teeter-dance.description: Teeter Dance Confusion all Pokémon adjacent to the user.

blaze-kick.name: Blaze Kick
blaze-kick.description: Blaze Kick deals damage and has an increased critical hit ratio. It has a 10% chance of burn the target.

slack-off.name: Slack Off
slack-off.description: Slack Off restores up to 50% of the user's maximum HP, rounded down.

mud-sport.name: Mud Sport
mud-sport.description: Mud Sport reduces the base power of Electric moves on both sides in battle.

ice-ball.name: Ice Ball
ice-ball.description: Ice Ball inflicts damage over five turns, doubling in power for each consecutive hit; the power will reset after five turns or if Ice Ball is interrupted. It is a . Ice Ball's power is doubled in addition if the user had previously used Defense Curl. Pokémon with Bulletproof are immune to Ice Ball.

needle-arm.name: Needle Arm
needle-arm.description: Needle Arm inflicts damage and has a 30% chance of causing the target to flinch. In Generation III only, Needle Arm will deal double the damage if its target had previously used Minimize.

blast-burn.name: Blast Burn
blast-burn.description: Blast Burn inflicts damage and then forces the user to recharge during the next turn. Unless this attack misses, the user will always have to recharge.

hydro-cannon.name: Hydro Cannon
hydro-cannon.description: Hydro Cannon inflicts damage and then forces the user to recharge during the next turn. Unless this attack misses, the user will always have to recharge.

meteor-mash.name: Meteor Mash
meteor-mash.description: Meteor Mash inflicts damage and has a 20% chance of raising the user's Attack stat by one stage. If used by a Pokémon with Iron Fist, its power is increased by 20%.

poison-fang.name: Poison Fang
poison-fang.description: Poison Fang inflicts damage and has a 30% chance of Badly poisoned the target.

astonish.name: Astonish

crush-claw.name: Crush Claw
crush-claw.description: Crush Claw inflicts damage and has a 50% chance of lowering the target's Defense stat by one stage.

hyper-voice.name: Hyper Voice
hyper-voice.description: Hyper Voice inflicts damage to all adjacent opponents.

air-cutter.name: Air Cutter
air-cutter.description: Air Cutter deals damage and has an increased critical hit ratio. It hits both opponents in a Double Battle and all opposing adjacent Pokémon in Triple Battles. Air Cutter's odds of landing critical hits is calculated for each hit opponent individually.

weather-ball.name: Weather Ball
weather-ball.description: Weather Ball deals damage. When the weather is clear, Weather Ball is a Normal move. During any type of weather except strong winds, Weather Ball's power doubles to 100. (Type-based power boosts from weather apply as normal, in addition to Weather Ball's effect.)

fake-tears.name: Fake Tears
fake-tears.description: Fake Tears lowers the target's Special Defense stat by two stages.

odor-sleuth.name: Odor Sleuth
odor-sleuth.description: Odor Sleuth causes all accuracy checks against the target to ignore any changes to the target's evasion stat stages. If Odor Sleuth's target is a Ghost Pokémon, it also removes the target's immunity to Fighting and Normal moves. Odor Sleuth's effect ends when the target switches out.

silver-wind.name: Silver Wind
silver-wind.description: Silver Wind inflicts damage and has a 10% chance of raising the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by one stage each.

overheat.name: Overheat
overheat.description: Overheat deals damage and lowers the user's Special Attack by two stages. Overheat makes contact with the target in this generation.

rock-tomb.name: Rock Tomb
rock-tomb.description: Rock Tomb deals damage and lowers the opponent's Speed by one stage. It has a power of 50, 10 PP, and 80% accuracy.

grass-whistle.name: Grass Whistle
grass-whistle.description: Grass Whistle puts the target to sleep.

aromatherapy.name: Aromatherapy
aromatherapy.description: Aromatherapy cures the user, all Pokémon in the user's party, and the user's allies, of all status conditions (sleep, poison, paralysis, freeze, and burn).

cosmic-power.name: Cosmic Power
cosmic-power.description: Cosmic Power boosts the Defense and Special Defense of the user by one stage each.

metal-sound.name: Metal Sound
metal-sound.description: Metal Sound lowers the target's Special Defense stat by two stages.

tickle.name: Tickle
tickle.description: Tickle lowers the target's Attack and Defense stats by one stage each.

shadow-punch.name: Shadow Punch
shadow-punch.description: Shadow Punch inflicts damage and bypasses accuracy checks to always hit, unless the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move such as Dig or Fly.

water-spout.name: Water Spout
water-spout.description: Water Spout deals damage. It has 150 base power at maximum HP, but its base power decreases proportionally to the user's remaining HP.

extrasensory.name: Extrasensory
extrasensory.description: Extrasensory inflicts damage and has a 10% chance of causing the target to flinch.

sky-uppercut.name: Sky Uppercut
sky-uppercut.description: Sky Uppercut deals damage and can hit Pokémon during the semi-invulnerable turns of Fly, Bounce, and Sky Drop.

When successful, the text " was trapped by SAND TOMB!" appears. It also traps the target, preventing switching and escape. If the user switches out, the target will be freed. If a trapped Pokémon uses Rapid Spin, it will be freed. If a wild Pokémon uses Sand Tomb on the player's Pokémon, the player may escape if the affected Pokémon has Run Away or is holding a Smoke Ball. However, these do not allow the player to switch the Pokémon out.

muddy-water.name: Muddy Water
muddy-water.description: Muddy Water inflicts damage and has a 30% chance of lowering each target's accuracy by one stage. Muddy Water targets all adjacent opponents.

wake-up-slap.name: Wake-Up Slap
wake-up-slap.description: Wake-Up Slap deals damage. If the target is Sleep, this move has double the power and causes the target to wake up.

water-pulse.name: Water Pulse
water-pulse.description: Water Pulse inflicts damage and has a 20% chance of Confusion the target. It can hit non-adjacent opponents in Triple Battles.

dragon-dance.name: Dragon Dance
dragon-dance.description: Dragon Dance raises the user's Attack stat and Speed stat by one stage each.

doom-desire.name: Doom Desire
doom-desire.description: On the turn Doom Desire is selected, this attack will do nothing other than state that the user has chosen Doom Desire as its destiny. Two turns later, Doom Desire will do damage against the target.

gravity.name: Gravity
gravity.description: Gravity causes the field to undergo intense gravity. This effect lasts 5 turns. It fails if used when Gravity is in effect.

gyro-ball.name: Gyro Ball

roost.name: Roost
roost.description: Roost restores up to 50% of the user's maximum HP, rounded down.

healing-wish.name: Healing Wish
healing-wish.description: Healing Wish causes the user to faint, then lets the Trainer switch in a new Pokémon. The new Pokémon's HP is restored and it is cured of any status conditions upon being sent out. Healing Wish will fail if its Trainer has no other conscious Pokémon in their party or if used by a wild Pokémon.

miracle-eye.name: Miracle Eye
miracle-eye.description: Miracle Eye causes accuracy checks against the target to ignore changes to the target's evasion stat stages if its evasion stat stage is greater than 0. If Miracle Eye's target is a Dark Pokémon, it also removes the target's immunity to Psychic moves. Miracle Eye's effect ends when the target switches out.

hammer-arm.name: Hammer Arm
hammer-arm.description: Hammer Arm deals damage and lowers the user's Speed by one stage.

brine.name: Brine
brine.description: Brine inflicts damage, and its power doubles to 130 when the target is at or below 50% health.

natural-gift.name: Natural Gift
natural-gift.description: Natural Gift inflicts damage and has no secondary effect. Natural Gift's power and type vary depending on the user's held Berry. Using Natural Gift consumes the held Berry, even if the move fails due to accuracy miss. The move will fail if the user is not holding a Berry, or if it cannot use its held Berry (due to Klutz, Magic Room, or Embargo).

payback.name: Payback
payback.description: Payback inflicts damage. Its power doubles to 100 if the user moves after the target, if the target switches out, or if the opponent uses an item.

acupressure.name: Acupressure
acupressure.description: Acupressure chooses one of the target's stats at random and raises it by two stages. It can raise either the target's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, Speed, accuracy, or evasion stat but will not attempt to raise a stat that is already maximized, meaning that the move will fail if all stats are maximized. Acupressure will also fail if the target has a , including if the target is the user.

feint.name: Feint
feint.description: Feint inflicts damage but only strikes a target that has used Protect or Detect during that turn, lifting the effects of Protect or Detect for the remainder of the turn. Feint cannot remove the effects of protecting moves if it misses or does not affect the target (such as if the target is Ghost).

metal-burst.name: Metal Burst
metal-burst.description: Metal Burst returns 1.5 times the damage dealt by the foe's last attack. Only the last damage taken will be counted, if the user is hit by a multi-hit move, only the damage from the final hit will be counted. Unlike Counter or Mirror Coat, Metal Burst does not require specifically physical or special damage sources and Metal Burst does not have decreased priority; if the user acts before it is hit by an opponent's damaging move, Metal Burst will fail. The move also fails if the user's is hit instead. In battles involving multiple Pokémon, Metal Burst will hit the last opponent that dealt damage to the user, even if that opponent is not adjacent to the user. However, if the last Pokémon to hit the user faints before the user moves, the remaining enemy Pokémon will be hit instead, like with a regular single-target damaging move (using the damage taken from the move of the now-fainted Pokémon that had hit the user). Metal Burst cannot affect allied Pokémon.

u-turn.name: U-turn
u-turn.description: U-turn deals damage and then switches the user out. The user will not be switched out if the user is the only Pokémon in the party that is able to battle, if U-turn triggers an opponent's Wimp Out or Emergency Exit Ability, or if using U-turn ends the battle. If U-turn knocks out an opponent Trainer's Pokémon, the next Pokémon sent out by the user will not be counted for additional experience, and if the user is battling an NPC, the player will still have the ability to switch Pokémon in between Pokémon that have fainted. If the next Pokémon sent out by the user is holding an Amulet Coin or Luck Incense, it will be counted for that even if it is immediately switched out in between fainted Pokémon.

tailwind.name: Tailwind
tailwind.description: Tailwind doubles the Speed stat of the user and all other Pokémon in the user's party for three turns.

close-combat.name: Close Combat
close-combat.description: Close Combat inflicts damage and then lowers the user's Defense stat and Special Defense stat by one stage each.

pluck.name: Pluck
pluck.description: Pluck inflicts damage. If the target is holding a Berry, the user will eat the Berry and gain its effect. Pluck will not eat the target's Berry if it hits its . Pluck will not consume the Berry of a target that has the Ability Sticky Hold.

embargo.name: Embargo
embargo.description: For five turns, the target's held item has its effects negated and its Trainer cannot use items from the Bag on it. The effect wears off if the Pokémon switches out.

psycho-shift.name: Psycho Shift
psycho-shift.description: Psycho Shift cures any non-volatile status condition the user has and afflicts the target with it.

fling.name: Fling
fling.description: Fling inflicts damage; the power of the move is determined by the user's held item.

heal-block.name: Heal Block
heal-block.description: Heal Block restricts the targets from healing in certain ways for five turns.

power-trick.name: Power Trick
power-trick.description: Power Trick causes the user to gain the Atk/Def Swapped status.

trump-card.name: Trump Card
trump-card.description: Trump Card inflicts damage and bypasses accuracy checks to always hit, unless the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move such as Dig or Fly.

copycat.name: Copycat
copycat.description: Copycat causes the user to use the last move that was used in the battle (even if the last move was by the user). If no move has been made, Copycat fails. If the copied move's target is not the user, an appropriate target is randomly chosen.

wring-out.name: Wring Out
wring-out.description: Wring Out deals damage. Its power is greater the more HP the target has.

me-first.name: Me First
me-first.description: If the target has not made its move this turn, but has selected a damage-dealing move, Me First copies that move preemptively and increases the power by 50%. It bypasses accuracy checks to always hit, unless the opponent is in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move such as Dig or Fly. Me First will fail if the target selected a non-damaging move, or if the target already executed its move this turn.

gastro-acid.name: Gastro Acid

last-resort.name: Last Resort
last-resort.description: Last Resort inflicts damage and has no secondary effect. Last Resort will fail unless the Pokémon has used all of its other moves at least once while on the field. Using a move before switching out and back in does not count towards being able to use Last Resort. Last Resort will fail if it is the only move the user knows, or if the user does not know Last Resort (such as if it is ).

worry-seed.name: Worry Seed
worry-seed.description: Worry Seed changes the target's Ability to Insomnia. If a Pokémon affected by Worry Seed is switched out, it regains its original Ability. Worry Seed can be used successfully even if the target's Ability is already Insomnia.

lucky-chant.name: Lucky Chant
lucky-chant.description: Lucky Chant prevents opponents from landing critical hits on the user's party for five turns, even if the move would always result in a critical hit (e.g. Frost Breath).

guard-swap.name: Guard Swap
guard-swap.description: Guard Swap switches the user's Defense stat stages and Special Defense stat stages with the target's Defense stat stages and Special Defense stat stages. Since this changes stat stages, the stat stages can be passed via Baton Pass.

power-swap.name: Power Swap
power-swap.description: Power Swap switches the user's Attack stat stages and Special Attack stat stages with the target's Attack stat stages and Special Attack stat stages. Since this changes stat stages, the stat stages can be passed via Baton Pass.

toxic-spikes.name: Toxic Spikes
toxic-spikes.description: Toxic Spikes sets an entry hazard around the target. One layer of Toxic Spikes causes opposing to acquire the poison status ailment upon switching in, while two or more layers causes opposing Pokémon to become Poison.

punishment.name: Punishment
punishment.description: Punishment deals damage. It normally has a base power of 60, but gains 20 power for every increased stat stage the target has, up to a maximum of 200 base power in total (i.e. capping at 7 positive stat stages). Stats decreased below normal do not affect this move's power.

heart-swap.name: Heart Swap
heart-swap.description: Heart Swap switches the user's stat stages with the target's stat stages. Since this changes stat stages, the stat stages can be passed via Baton Pass.

assurance.name: Assurance
assurance.description: Assurance inflicts damage and will deal double damage if the target has already received damage on the turn it is used. This includes self-inflicted and indirect damage, such as damage from a Life Orb, recoil, crash damage, or hurting itself in confusion.

aqua-ring.name: Aqua Ring
aqua-ring.description: Aqua Ring causes the user to gain the Aqua Ring status, which surrounds it in a veil of water and restores 1/16 of its maximum HP (rounded down) at the end of every turn.

sucker-punch.name: Sucker Punch
sucker-punch.description: Sucker Punch has a priority of +1, so it is used before all moves that do not have increased priority. If Sucker Punch's target has selected a physical or special attack and has not yet had a chance to execute its move, Sucker Punch will damage the target; otherwise, Sucker Punch will fail. Sucker Punch only depends on the move the target has selected, and is not affected by any consideration of whether the attack was actually executed, such as due to status conditions like sleep or freeze, or like Truant stopping the execution of a move or Encore making the target use a different move.

magnet-rise.description: The user becomes immune to Ground attacks for five turns. Like Flying Pokémon and Pokémon with Levitate, the user becomes ungrounded which makes it immune to various effects related to the ground. Magnet Rise fails if the user is under the effects of Ingrain and cannot be selected if Gravity is in effect.

ice-shard.description: Ice Shard inflicts damage. It has a priority of +1, so is used before all moves that do not have increased priority.

zen-headbutt.name: Zen Headbutt
zen-headbutt.description: Zen Headbutt inflicts damage and has a 20% chance of causing the target to flinch.

shadow-sneak.name: Shadow Sneak
shadow-sneak.description: Shadow Sneak inflicts damage. It has a priority of +1, so it is used before all moves that do not have increased priority.

psycho-cut.name: Psycho Cut
psycho-cut.description: Psycho Cut deals damage and has an increased critical hit ratio. If used by a Pokémon with Sharpness, its power is increased by 50%.

mirror-shot.name: Mirror Shot
mirror-shot.description: Mirror Shot inflicts damage and has a 30% chance to lower the target's accuracy by one stage.

fire-fang.name: Fire Fang
fire-fang.description: Fire Fang deals damage and has a 10% chance of burning the opponent. It also has an independent 10% chance of causing the target to flinch, if the user attacks before the target.

ice-fang.name: Ice Fang
ice-fang.description: Ice Fang deals damage and has a 10% chance of Freeze the opponent. It also has an independent 10% chance of causing the target to flinch, if the user attacks before the target.

trick-room.name: Trick Room
trick-room.description: Trick Room reverses the move order within each priority bracket so that Pokémon with a lower Speed stat attack first, while those with a higher Speed stat will attack last. Individual brackets are still maintained; moves in higher priority brackets still work before moves in lower ones regardless of Trick Room. This effect lasts for five turns, and using Trick Room counts as the first turn. Similar to Magic Room and Wonder Room, using Trick Room while it is already in effect will end it immediately.

draco-meteor.name: Draco Meteor
draco-meteor.description: Draco Meteor inflicts damage and lowers the user's Special Attack by two stages.

defog.name: Defog
defog.description: Defog lowers the target's evasion one stage, even if the target is behind a . It bypasses accuracy checks to always hit, unless the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move such as Dig or Fly.

discharge.name: Discharge
discharge.description: Discharge damages all Pokémon except the user in Double Battles and has a 30% chance of Paralysis each of them. In Triple Battles, Discharge damages all adjacent Pokémon.

rock-climb.name: Rock Climb
rock-climb.description: Rock Climb inflicts damage and has a 20% chance of confusion the opponent.

rock-wrecker.name: Rock Wrecker
rock-wrecker.description: Rock Wrecker inflicts damage and then forces the user to recharge during the next turn. Unless this attack misses, the user will always have to recharge.

lava-plume.name: Lava Plume
lava-plume.description: Lava Plume damages all adjacent Pokémon in Double and Triple Battles. It also has a 30% chance of burning each of them.

power-whip.name: Power Whip
power-whip.description: Power Whip inflicts damage and has no secondary effect.

cross-poison.name: Cross Poison
cross-poison.description: Cross Poison deals damage and has an increased critical hit ratio. It has a 10% chance of poisoning the opponent. If used by a Pokémon with Sharpness, its power is increased by 50%.

iron-head.name: Iron Head
iron-head.description: Iron Head inflicts damage and has a 30% chance of causing the target to flinch.

stone-edge.name: Stone Edge
stone-edge.description: Stone Edge deals damage and has an increased critical hit ratio.

gunk-shot.name: Gunk Shot
gunk-shot.description: Gunk Shot deals damage and has a 30% chance of poisoning the target.

magnet-bomb.name: Magnet Bomb
magnet-bomb.description: Magnet Bomb inflicts damage and bypasses accuracy checks to always hit, unless the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move such as Dig or Fly.

grass-knot.name: Grass Knot
grass-knot.description: Grass Knot doesn't have a standard base power; rather, its damage is calculated based on the weight of the target. Grass Knot's power is calculated as follows (note that the game uses weight in kilograms instead of pounds for all the cutoffs).

stealth-rock.name: Stealth Rock
stealth-rock.description: Stealth Rock sets an entry hazard around the target Pokémon. Pokémon on the target's field receive damage upon switching in. The amount of damage inflicted upon switching in is affected by the effectiveness of Rock against the target, starting at 1/8 of the target's maximum HP at normal effectiveness. Stealth Rock does not stack. It does not damage Pokémon with the Ability Magic Guard. Rapid Spin removes Stealth Rock from the user's side of the field if it affects its target; Defog removes the effect of Stealth Rock from the target's side of the field if it affects its target.

captivate.name: Captivate
captivate.description: Captivate lowers the Special Attack stat of the target by two stages, if it is the opposite gender of the user. It targets all adjacent opponents. Gender-unknown Pokémon (such as Magnemite) and Pokémon with the Ability Oblivious are unaffected by this move. It always fails if the user is a gender-unknown Pokémon.

bug-bite.name: Bug Bite
bug-bite.description: Bug Bite inflicts damage. If the target is holding a Berry, the user will eat the Berry and gain its effect. Bug Bite will not eat the target's Berry if it hits its . Bug Bite will not consume the Berry of a target that has the Ability Sticky Hold.

aqua-jet.name: Aqua Jet
aqua-jet.description: Aqua Jet inflicts damage. It has a priority of +1, so is used before all moves that do not have increased priority.

flash-cannon.name: Flash Cannon
flash-cannon.description: Flash Cannon does damage and has a 10% chance of lowering the target's Special Defense by one stage.

charge-beam.name: Charge Beam
charge-beam.description: Charge Beam deals damage and has a 70% chance of raising the user's Special Attack by one stage.

chatter.name: Chatter
chatter.description: Chatter inflicts damage and can Confusion the target.

wood-hammer.name: Wood Hammer
wood-hammer.description: Wood Hammer inflicts damage, and the user receives recoil damage equal to 33% of the damage done to the target.

judgment.name: Judgment
judgment.description: Judgment inflicts damage and has no secondary effect. The type of Judgment depends on the type of Plate held by the user, being Normal-type if there is no held Plate.

heal-order.name: Heal Order
heal-order.description: Heal Order restores up to 50% of the user's maximum HP, rounded down.

defend-order.name: Defend Order
defend-order.description: Defend Order increases the user's Defense and Special Defense stats by one stage each.

attack-order.name: Attack Order
attack-order.description: Attack Order deals damage and has an increased critical hit ratio.

head-smash.name: Head Smash
head-smash.description: Head Smash inflicts damage, and the user receives recoil damage equal to ½ of the damage done to the target.

double-hit.name: Double Hit
double-hit.description: Double Hit inflicts damage, hitting twice per use. Each strike has an equal chance to be a critical hit.

seed-flare.name: Seed Flare
seed-flare.description: Seed Flare inflicts damage and has a 40% chance of lowering the target's Special Defense stat by two stages.

lunar-dance.name: Lunar Dance
lunar-dance.description: Lunar Dance causes the user to faint, but restores the HP and PP of the Pokémon that is sent out to take its place as well as removing all status conditions (except fainting).

magma-storm.name: Magma Storm
magma-storm.description: Magma Storm deals damage and binds the target for two to five turns. A bound target cannot switch out or flee, and takes damage equal to 1/16 of its maximum HP at the end of each turn. If the user switches out, the target will be freed. If a bound Pokémon uses Rapid Spin, it will be freed. If a Pokémon has Run Away or is holding a Smoke Ball, it can flee even when bound (but still cannot switch out); if a Pokémon has a Shed Shell, it can switch out even when bound (but cannot flee). A Pokémon can only be bound by one move at a time, and the effect disappears if the user is no longer on the field.

shadow-force.name: Shadow Force
shadow-force.description: Shadow Force causes the user to "vanish instantly" on the turn it is selected, giving it the Concealed status, and then reappear the next turn to cause damage.

ominous-wind.name: Ominous Wind
ominous-wind.description: Ominous Wind inflicts damage and has a 10% chance of raising the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by one stage each.

roar-of-time.name: Roar of Time
roar-of-time.description: Roar of Time inflicts damage and then forces the user to recharge during the next turn. Unless the move fails due to missing, type immunity, or is blocked by a , the user will always have to recharge the next turn.

dark-void.name: Dark Void
dark-void.description: Dark Void puts all adjacent foes to sleep.

spacial-rend.name: Spacial Rend
spacial-rend.description: Spacial Rend deals damage and has an increased critical hit ratio.

hone-claws.name: Hone Claws
hone-claws.description: Hone Claws raises the user's Attack and accuracy by one stage each.

guard-split.name: Guard Split
guard-split.description: Guard Split averages the user's Defense and Special Defense stats with those of the target Pokémon. Both the user's and the target's stat changes are ignored when calculating the average.

crush-grip.name: Crush Grip
crush-grip.description: Crush Grip deals damage. Its power is greater the more HP the target has.

wide-guard.name: Wide Guard
wide-guard.description: Wide Guard protects all Pokémon on the user's side of the field for the rest of that turn from moves that can target multiple Pokémon, even those used by an ally that strike all Pokémon on the field (such as Earthquake and Surf). Wide Guard will block these moves even in Single Battles. The protection granted by Wide Guard goes on until the end of the turn even if the user faints during the turn.

power-split.name: Power Split
power-split.description: Power Split averages the user's Attack and Special Attack stats with those of the target Pokémon. Power Split will ignore both the user and the target's stat changes when calculating the average.

venoshock.name: Venoshock
venoshock.description: Venoshock inflicts damage. Its power is doubled to 130 if the target is poisoned.

psyshock.name: Psyshock
psyshock.description: and Body Press: stat stage modifiers of the target's Defense and non-stage stat modifiers of its Special Defense.}} Psyshock inflicts damage. Psyshock uses the target's Defense instead of its Special Defense to calculate damage. Otherwise, it is considered a special move: it uses the user's Special Attack, activates Mirror Coat and Maranga Berry (not Counter or Kee Berry), has its damage reduced by Light Screen (not Reflect), etc. It does not activate Toxic Debris.

autotomize.name: Autotomize
autotomize.description: Autotomize raises the user's Speed stat by two stages and (if the user successfully changes its Speed) decreases its weight by 220 lbs. (100 kg). If the user successfully changes its weight, the message " became nimble!" is displayed.

wonder-room.name: Wonder Room
wonder-room.description: Wonder Room swaps the Defense and Special Defense of all Pokémon, but stat changes remain on their respective stat. This effect lasts for five turns. Similar to Magic Room and Trick Room, using Wonder Room while it is already in effect will end it immediately.

telekinesis.name: Telekinesis
telekinesis.description: Telekinesis raises its target into the air for three turns. This makes all moves used against the target (with the exception of one-hit knockout moves) bypass accuracy checks to always hit, unless the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move such as Dig or Fly. In addition, the target will be immune to Ground moves and ungrounded. This effect is passed by Baton Pass.

storm-throw.name: Storm Throw
storm-throw.description: Storm Throw inflicts damage and will always result in a critical hit if possible (i.e. unless the target has Battle Armor or Shell Armor, or is under the effects of Lucky Chant).

smack-down.name: Smack Down
smack-down.description: Smack Down inflicts damage. If the target is off the ground, it gains the Landed status.

synchronoise.name: Synchronoise
synchronoise.description: Synchronoise damages all adjacent Pokémon that share at least one type with the user. If the user has multiple types, any Pokémon that has any of those types will be damaged.

magic-room.name: Magic Room
magic-room.description: Magic Room suppresses the effect of all items held by the Pokémon on the field. This effect lasts for five turns. Using Magic Room while it is already in effect will remove the effects of Magic Room immediately. Items regain their effects as soon as Magic Room ends.

rage-powder.name: Rage Powder
rage-powder.description: Rage Powder makes the user the center of attention, forcing opposing Pokémon to use their moves on the user rather than the intended target (even if it was a friendly target, unless it is a move that cannot target an opponent such as Acupressure or Helping Hand) for the rest of the turn. If a move cannot target the center of attention, it will be used on its intended target. It does not affect allies.

sludge-wave.name: Sludge Wave
sludge-wave.description: Sludge Wave inflicts damage and has a 10% chance of poisoning the target. Sludge Wave will hit all Pokémon in Double Battles and all adjacent Pokémon in Triple Battles.

heavy-slam.name: Heavy Slam
heavy-slam.description: Heavy Slam deals damage. Its power depends on the weight of both the user and the target; the lighter the target is in comparison to the user, the greater the power:

quiver-dance.name: Quiver Dance
quiver-dance.description: Quiver Dance raises the user's Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed stats by one stage each.

flame-burst.name: Flame Burst
flame-burst.description: Flame Burst deals damage to the target, then inflicts damage to up to two Pokémon adjacent to that target (including the user if targeting an ally) equal to of their respective maximum HP. Except in Battle Royals, the extra damage is dealt to the up to two Pokémon that are both allied with and adjacent to the target; in Battle Royals, the extra damage is dealt to the other two opposing Pokémon. The extra damage is not inflicted if the target was not affected by Flame Burst (such as due to Flame Burst missing, Flash Fire, or being ).

electro-ball.name: Electro Ball
electro-ball.description: Electro Ball inflicts more damage the faster the user is compared to the target.

soak.name: Soak
soak.description: Soak changes the target's type to pure Water. The effect lasts as long as the target remains in battle; however, changing form or transforming overrides the effect. Soak succeeds even if the target is already a pure Water-type Pokémon.

coil.name: Coil
coil.description: Coil raises the user's Attack, Defense, and accuracy stats by one stage each.

flame-charge.name: Flame Charge
flame-charge.description: Flame Charge inflicts damage and raises the user's Speed by one stage.

low-sweep.name: Low Sweep
low-sweep.description: Low Sweep inflicts damage and lowers the target's Speed stat by one stage.

foul-play.name: Foul Play
foul-play.description: Foul Play inflicts damage. It uses the target's Attack stat to calculate damage instead of the user's.

round.name: Round
round.description: Round inflicts damage. If another Pokémon uses Round before the user this turn, the user will use Round directly after it (regardless of Speed); all but the first Round within a turn will double in power to 120.

entrainment.name: Entrainment
entrainment.description: Entrainment changes the target's Ability to match the user's. If a Pokémon affected by Entrainment is switched out, it regains its original Ability.

after-you.name: After You
after-you.description: The target will move next on the current turn, ignoring priority. After You bypasses accuracy checks to always hit, unless the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move such as Dig or Fly. It fails if the target has already moved on the same turn. After You ignores the effects of Quash. It hits through a .

simple-beam.name: Simple Beam
simple-beam.description: Simple Beam changes the target's Ability to Simple. If a Pokémon affected by Simple Beam is switched out, it regains its original Ability.

acid-spray.name: Acid Spray
acid-spray.description: Acid Spray inflicts damage and lowers the target's Special Defense by two stages. It has no effect on Pokémon with the Bulletproof Ability.

chip-away.name: Chip Away
chip-away.description: Chip Away inflicts damage, ignoring any changes to the target's Defense and evasion stat stages — positive and negative. It does not ignore changes to stats that do not use stat stages, such as Reflect, such as Sand Veil, or items such as Eviolite. It also does not ignore changes to the user's Attack or accuracy.

clear-smog.name: Clear Smog
clear-smog.description: Clear Smog inflicts damage and resets all stat levels of the target to 0; unlike Haze, this move only hits one target, rather than affecting every Pokémon on the field. This effect does not work if the target is unaffected by the attack because of type immunity, , or is behind a . However, it does work against the boss of a Max Raid Battle even if it has a shield up.

quick-guard.name: Quick Guard
quick-guard.description: Quick Guard protects all Pokémon on the user's side of the field from moves that have increased priority during that turn, such as Quick Attack or Aqua Jet.

ally-switch.name: Ally Switch
ally-switch.description: Ally Switch causes the user to switch places with the ally opposite to itself, and is an increased-priority move. It will fail if the user is in the middle of the field in a Triple Battle, if the user has no ally opposite it, or if used in a Single Battle, Multi Battle, Rotation Battle, Horde Encounter, Max Raid, or Tera Raid.

scald.name: Scald
scald.description: Scald inflicts damage and has a 30% chance of burning the target. Upon execution, Scald will thaw the user if frozen (even if the move fails to hit the target).

hex.name: Hex
hex.description: Hex's base power is 50 and will double to 100 when the target is affected by a .

stored-power.name: Stored Power
stored-power.description: Stored Power deals damage. It normally has a base power of 20, but gains 20 power for every increased stat stage the user has. Stats decreased below normal do not affect this move's base power.

shift-gear.name: Shift Gear
shift-gear.description: Shift Gear increases the user's Speed by two stages and the user's Attack by one stage.

shell-smash.name: Shell Smash
shell-smash.description: Shell Smash decreases the user's Defense and Special Defense stat by one stage, but increases the user's Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by two stages each.

incinerate.name: Incinerate
incinerate.description: Incinerate inflicts damage to all adjacent opponents. It destroys any held by the hit Pokémon. The Occa Berry will activate before being burned up. Berries that would activate in response to Incinerate, such as the Oran Berry or Rowap Berry, are destroyed before they have a chance to be consumed.

heal-pulse.name: Heal Pulse
heal-pulse.description: Heal Pulse restores up to 50% (75% if the user has Mega Launcher) of the target's maximum HP. Heal Pulse bypasses accuracy checks to always hit, unless the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move such as Dig or Fly. It can hit non-adjacent targets in Triple Battles.

sky-drop.name: Sky Drop
sky-drop.description: On the turn it is selected, Sky Drop brings the target to the air. While in the air, the target cannot act. While in the air, both the user and the target avoid any move targeted at them (except Gust, Thunder, Twister, Sky Uppercut, Hurricane, or Smack Down). The next turn, the target is thrown down and receives damage. Sky Drop does no damage to Flying Pokémon, but it will still pick them up (making them unable to move) on its first turn.

reflect-type.name: Reflect Type
reflect-type.description: Reflect Type changes the user's type to match the type or types of the target. If the target has had a type added by Forest's Curse or Trick-or-Treat, Reflect Type will also copy the added Grass or Ghost type respectively. Reflect Type successfully copies the target's type even if it is disguised by Illusion. It bypasses accuracy checks to always hit, unless the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move such as Dig or Fly.

circle-throw.name: Circle Throw
circle-throw.description: Circle Throw inflicts damage and has decreased priority. In a Trainer battle, it will switch out the target to the next Pokémon in line that has not fainted (if there is one). In a wild Pokémon battle with a single wild Pokémon, this move will cause the battle to end if the user's level is equal or greater than the target's; however, if there are multiple wild Pokémon in the battle (or were previously), it works the same as in a Trainer battle.

quash.name: Quash
quash.description: The target of Quash will act last in that turn, ignoring priority, provided it has not yet acted. The effect of Quash is ignored by After You.

acrobatics.name: Acrobatics
acrobatics.description: Acrobatics deals damage and its power is doubled to 110 if the user has no held item. Acrobatics can hit non-adjacent opponents in Triple Battles. If the user is holding a Flying Gem, the item is consumed before this move checks whether the Pokémon has an item or not; therefore, the power is still doubled.

retaliate.name: Retaliate
retaliate.description: Retaliate inflicts damage. Its base power doubles from 70 to 140 if a from the user's party has fainted in the previous turn.

bestow.name: Bestow
bestow.description: The user transfers its held item to the target. It fails if the user has no held item, the target already has a held item, or the target is behind a . Bestow bypasses accuracy checks to always hit, unless the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move such as Dig or Fly. It is blocked by Protect and Detect.

final-gambit.name: Final Gambit
final-gambit.description: Final Gambit causes the user to faint, and the target receives damage equal to the user's remaining HP before using Final Gambit.

inferno.name: Inferno
inferno.description: Inferno deals damage and will always burn the target if it hits.

volt-switch.name: Volt Switch
volt-switch.description: Volt Switch deals damage and then switches the user out. The same Pokémon cannot be sent back out after using Volt Switch. The user will not be switched out if the user is the only in the party that is able to battle, if Volt Switch fails to hit the target, if the opponent is not affected by Volt Switch, if Volt Switch triggers an opponent's Wimp Out or Emergency Exit Ability, or if using Volt Switch ends the battle. If Volt Switch knocks out an opposing Trainer's Pokémon, the next Pokémon sent out by the user will not be counted for additional experience (although if it is holding an Amulet Coin or Luck Incense, it will be counted for that).

struggle-bug.name: Struggle Bug
struggle-bug.description: Struggle Bug inflicts damage to all adjacent opponents and lowers the targets' Special Attack by one stage.

bulldoze.name: Bulldoze
bulldoze.description: Bulldoze inflicts damage and lowers the target's Speed stat by one stage. In Double Battles, it strikes both the opponents and the user's partner. In Triple Battles, it strikes all adjacent Pokémon.

frost-breath.name: Frost Breath
frost-breath.description: Frost Breath inflicts damage and will always result in a critical hit if possible (i.e. unless the target has Battle Armor or Shell Armor, or is under the effects of Lucky Chant).

electroweb.name: Electroweb
electroweb.description: Electroweb inflicts damage and then lowers the target's Speed stat by one stage.

dragon-tail.name: Dragon Tail
dragon-tail.description: Dragon Tail inflicts damage and has decreased priority. In a Trainer battle, it will switch out the target to the next Pokémon in line that has not fainted (if there is one). In a wild Pokémon battle with a single wild Pokémon, this move will cause the battle to end if the user's level is equal or greater than the target's; however, if there are multiple wild Pokémon in the battle (or were previously), it works the same as in a Trainer battle.

work-up.name: Work Up
work-up.description: Work Up raises the user's Attack and Special Attack stats by one stage each.

drill-run.name: Drill Run
drill-run.description: Drill Run deals damage and has an increased critical hit ratio.

wild-charge.name: Wild Charge
wild-charge.description: Wild Charge inflicts damage, and the user receives recoil damage equal to ¼ of the damage done to the target.

dual-chop.name: Dual Chop
dual-chop.description: Dual Chop inflicts damage, hitting twice per use. Each strike has an equal chance to be a critical hit.

sacred-sword.name: Sacred Sword
sacred-sword.description: Sacred Sword inflicts damage, ignoring the target's Defense stat changes. If used by a Pokémon with Sharpness, its power is increased by 50%.

heart-stamp.name: Heart Stamp
heart-stamp.description: Heart Stamp inflicts damage and has a 30% chance of causing the target to flinch.

horn-leech.name: Horn Leech
horn-leech.description: Horn Leech inflicts damage, and up to 50% of the damage dealt to the target is restored to the user as HP. If this attack deals 1 HP of damage, 1 HP will be restored to the user.
