Psystrike uses the target's Defense instead of its Special Defense to calculate damage. Otherwise, it is considered a special move: it uses the user's Special Attack, activates Mirror Coat and Maranga Berry (not Counter or Kee Berry), has its damage reduced by Light Screen (not Reflect), etc.

heat-crash.name: Heat Crash
heat-crash.description: Heat Crash deals damage. Its power depends on the weight of both the user and the target; the greater the difference between the user's weight and the target's weight, the greater the power:

cotton-guard.name: Cotton Guard
cotton-guard.description: Cotton Guard raises the user's Defense stat by three stages.

razor-shell.name: Razor Shell
razor-shell.description: Razor Shell inflicts damage and has a 50% chance of lowering the target's Defense stat by one stage. If used by a Pokémon with Sharpness, its power is increased by 50%.

night-daze.name: Night Daze
night-daze.description: Night Daze deals damage and has a 40% chance of lowering the target's accuracy by one stage.

steamroller.name: Steamroller
steamroller.description: Steamroller inflicts damage and has a 30% chance of causing the target to flinch. Steamroller cannot make a target with a flinch.

leaf-tornado.name: Leaf Tornado
leaf-tornado.description: Leaf Tornado inflicts damage and has a 50% chance to lower the target's accuracy by one stage.

hurricane.name: Hurricane
hurricane.description: Hurricane deals damage and has a 30% chance of Confusion the target. Hurricane can hit non-adjacent targets in Triple Battles.

tail-slap.name: Tail Slap
tail-slap.description: Tail Slap inflicts damage, hitting the target 2-5 times per use. Each strike made has an equal chance to be a critical hit.

gear-grind.name: Gear Grind
gear-grind.description: Gear Grind inflicts damage, hitting twice per use. Each strike has an equal chance to be a critical hit.

head-charge.name: Head Charge
head-charge.description: Head Charge inflicts damage, and the user receives recoil damage equal to ¼ of the damage done to the target.

relic-song.name: Relic Song
relic-song.description: Relic Song deals damage and has a 10% chance of putting the target to sleep. Relic Song hits all adjacent opponents.

secret-sword.name: Secret Sword
secret-sword.description: and Body Press: stat stage modifiers of the target's Defense and non-stage stat modifiers of its Special Defense.}} Secret Sword inflicts damage. Secret Sword uses the target's Defense instead of its Special Defense to calculate damage. Otherwise, it is considered a special move: it uses the user's Special Attack, activates Mirror Coat and Maranga Berry (not Counter or Kee Berry), has its damage reduced by Light Screen (not Reflect), etc.

searing-shot.name: Searing Shot
searing-shot.description: Searing Shot deals damage and has a 30% chance to burn the target. It does not affect opponents with Bulletproof.

bolt-strike.name: Bolt Strike
bolt-strike.description: Bolt Strike inflicts damage and has a 20% chance of paralyzing the target.

fiery-dance.name: Fiery Dance
fiery-dance.description: Fiery Dance inflicts damage and has a 50% chance of raising the user's Special Attack stat by one stage.

blue-flare.name: Blue Flare
blue-flare.description: Blue Flare inflicts damage and has a 20% chance of burn the target.

glaciate.name: Glaciate
glaciate.description: Glaciate inflicts damage and lowers the target's Speed stat by one stage. Glaciate hits all opponents in Double Battles and all adjacent opponents in Triple Battles.

freeze-shock.name: Freeze Shock
freeze-shock.description: Freeze Shock deals damage and has a 30% chance of Paralysis the target.

ice-burn.name: Ice Burn
ice-burn.description: Ice Burn deals damage and has a 30% chance of Burn the target.

techno-blast.name: Techno Blast
techno-blast.description: Techno Blast inflicts damage and has no secondary effect. The type of Techno Blast depends on the type of Drive held by the user, being Normal-type if there is none held, and Electric, Fire, Ice, or Water with the appropriate Drive.

fusion-bolt.name: Fusion Bolt
fusion-bolt.description: Fusion Bolt inflicts damage. The base power of Fusion Bolt will double if any Pokémon has successfully used Fusion Flare previously in the same turn, with no intervening moves in between, except perhaps for failed moves. If this power increase applies, it also causes Fusion Bolt to have a different animation than normal. Likewise, Fusion Bolt will cause a later Fusion Flare to have doubled power if it's the next successful move used in the same turn.

flying-press.name: Flying Press
flying-press.description: Flying Press deals damage. Despite being a Fighting move, the damage dealt is actually a combination of Fighting and Flying types, and thus its effectiveness against a given Pokémon differs from other Fighting-type moves. However, for all other purposes, it is a Fighting-type move: only Fighting-type Pokémon can receive the same-type attack bonus on Flying Press, it is unaffected by items like the Sky Plate and Flying Gem, and it will not activate the target's Coba Berry (but will activate Chople Berry even in cases where a regular Fighting move would not deal supereffective damage).

fusion-flare.name: Fusion Flare
fusion-flare.description: Fusion Flare inflicts damage. The base power of Fusion Flare will double if any Pokémon has successfully used Fusion Bolt previously in the same turn, with no intervening moves in between, except perhaps for failed moves. If this power increase applies, it also causes Fusion Flare to have a different animation than normal. Likewise, Fusion Flare will cause a later Fusion Bolt to have doubled power if it's the next successful move used in the same turn. If the user is freeze, Fusion Flare will thaw it before using the move.

v-create.name: V-create
v-create.description: V-create deals damage, then lowers the user's Defense, Special Defense, and Speed stats by one stage each.

rototiller.name: Rototiller
rototiller.description: Rototiller raises the Attack and Special Attack stats of all grounded Grass Pokémon on the field by one stage, except those that are in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move such as Fly or Dig. Rototiller fails if there are no eligible Grass-type Pokémon.

belch.name: Belch
belch.description: Belch deals damage. It cannot be selected unless the user has previously eaten a Berry in the current battle. This includes eating another Pokémon's held Berry via Bug Bite, Pluck, or being hit by Fling, unless the Berry can never have an effect when eaten that way. Consuming a Berry through other means (such as Natural Gift, using Fling, or its Trainer giving it a Berry from the Bag) will not enable Belch to be used.

snarl.name: Snarl
snarl.description: Snarl deals damage and lowers the Special Attack of all targets hit by one stage. Snarl hits all adjacent opponents in Triple Battles.

sticky-web.name: Sticky Web
sticky-web.description: Sticky Web sets an entry hazard around the opposing Pokémon, which lowers their Speed stat by one stage upon switching in. It doesn't affect Flying Pokémon, Pokémon with either the Levitate or Eelevate Ability, or Pokémon holding an Air Balloon.

icicle-crash.name: Icicle Crash
icicle-crash.description: Icicle Crash inflicts damage and has a 30% chance of causing the target to flinch.

mat-block.name: Mat Block
mat-block.description: Mat Block protects all Pokémon on the user's side of the field from any physical or special moves for that turn. Unlike Protect, Mat Block is not an increased priority move. Mat Block will fail if not used on the first turn after the Pokémon enters the field; the Pokémon must be switched out and back in to be able to use Mat Block again.

phantom-force.name: Phantom Force
phantom-force.description: Phantom Force causes the user to "vanish instantly" on the turn it is used, giving it the Concealed status, and then reappear the next turn causing damage.

fell-stinger.name: Fell Stinger
fell-stinger.description: Fell Stinger inflicts damage; if it causes the targeted Pokémon to faint, the user's Attack stat rises by two stages.

noble-roar.name: Noble Roar
noble-roar.description: Noble Roar lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack stats by one stage.

trick-or-treat.name: Trick-or-Treat
trick-or-treat.description: Trick-or-Treat adds the Ghost type to the target, in addition to the Pokémon's original type(s). If it is used against a dual-type Pokémon, that Pokémon will have three types at once. If the target already has an additional type added to it by Forest's Curse, that type is replaced with the Ghost type. Trick-or-Treat will fail if the target Pokémon is already Ghost type. This additional type can be copied by Reflect Type. If a Pokémon changes forms while affected by Trick-or-Treat, its effect will be removed and the Pokémon will no longer have the Ghost type.

ion-deluge.name: Ion Deluge
ion-deluge.description: For the remainder of the current turn, Ion Deluge causes all Normal moves to become Electric instead, including status moves. Ion Deluge has a priority of +1, so it is used before all moves that do not have increased priority.

parabolic-charge.name: Parabolic Charge
parabolic-charge.description: Parabolic Charge inflicts damage and restores the user's HP equal to half of the damage dealt.

disarming-voice.name: Disarming Voice
disarming-voice.description: Disarming Voice inflicts damage and bypasses accuracy checks to always hit, unless the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move such as Dig or Fly. Disarming Voice can hit Pokémon even if they are behind a substitute.

forests-curse.name: Forest’s Curse
forests-curse.description: The user puts a forest curse on the target. This adds Grass type to the target's type.

freeze-dry.name: Freeze-Dry
freeze-dry.description: Freeze-Dry deals damage. Freeze-Dry will always deal supereffective (×2) damage to Water targets, even during Inverse Battles or if its type is changed.

topsy-turvy.name: Topsy-Turvy
topsy-turvy.description: Topsy-Turvy reverses all stat modifiers on the target Pokémon, making positive changes negative and vice versa. If all the target's stat stages are neutral (equal to 0), Topsy-Turvy fails. In this generation, Topsy-Turvy has an accuracy of 100.

petal-blizzard.name: Petal Blizzard
petal-blizzard.description: Petal Blizzard does damage to all adjacent Pokémon, including allies. In Horde Encounters, it will target all opponents. Petal Blizzard will also destroy grass patches found in the background of battles.

parting-shot.name: Parting Shot
parting-shot.description: Parting Shot lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack stats by one stage each, and then switches the user out.

flower-shield.name: Flower Shield
flower-shield.description: Flower Shield raises the Defense stat of all Grass Pokémon on the field by one stage, except those that are in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move such as Fly or Dig. Flower Shield fails if there are no eligible Grass-type Pokémon.

draining-kiss.name: Draining Kiss
draining-kiss.description: Draining Kiss does damage and restores the user's HP by 75% of the damage dealt.

crafty-shield.name: Crafty Shield
crafty-shield.description: Crafty Shield protects all Pokémon on the user's side of the field from status moves. It does not protect against moves that the user is using on itself or that target the user's side of the field (so an ally can still use Acupressure or Aromatherapy on itself). It also does not protect against entry hazard moves or such as Perish Song.

electrify.name: Electrify
electrify.description: If the target has not yet used a move, Electrify makes the target's move Electric for that turn, even if it is a status move. will only change type if the user is affected by Electrify on the turn it does damage. Electrify will not cause Conversion to change its user into the Electric-type if Conversion is the user's first move. Electrify does not affect Struggle.

grassy-terrain.name: Grassy Terrain
grassy-terrain.description: Grassy Terrain creates terrain that envelops the field for five turns and replaces the background environment and any other terrain that is already in effect. It has the following effects on Pokémon that are on the ground and not in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move: * It boosts the power of Grass-type moves used by affected Pokémon by 50% (regardless of whether the target of the move is affected by the terrain). * At the end of each turn, it restores the HP of each affected Pokémon by 1/16 of its maximum HP. * It causes Floral Healing to restore up to ⅔ of the target's maximum HP instead of the usual ½. * Bulldoze, Earthquake, and Magnitude's power is halved when used against affected targets (regardless of whether the user of the move is affected by the terrain). * Nature Power becomes Energy Ball. * Secret Power uses the animation of Vine Whip and has a 30% chance of causing the target to sleep. * Camouflage causes the user to become Grass-type.

play-rough.name: Play Rough
play-rough.description: Play Rough inflicts damage and has a 10% chance of lowering the target's Attack stat by one stage.

fairy-wind.name: Fairy Wind
fairy-wind.description: Fairy Wind inflicts damage and has no secondary effect.

misty-terrain.name: Misty Terrain
misty-terrain.description: Misty Terrain creates terrain that envelops the field for five turns and replaces the background environment and any other terrain that is already in effect. It has the following effects on that are on the ground and not in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move. *It halves the power of Dragon moves used against affected Pokémon (regardless of whether the user of the move is affected by Misty Terrain). *It prevents affected Pokémon from being afflicted by non-volatile status conditions (but does not cure Pokémon already afflicted with one). **If an affected Pokémon is drowsy due to Yawn, it is prevented from falling asleep. **Rest will fail if used by an affected Pokémon. *Nature Power becomes Moonblast. *Secret Power uses the animation of Fairy Wind and may lower its target's Special Attack stat. *Camouflage causes the user to become Fairy.

fairy-lock.name: Fairy Lock
fairy-lock.description: Fairy Lock prevents all Pokémon (except Ghost types) on the field from switching out or fleeing during their next turn.

kings-shield.name: King’s Shield
kings-shield.description: The user takes a defensive stance while it protects itself from damage. It also lowers the Attack stat of any attacker that makes direct contact.

boomburst.name: Boomburst
boomburst.description: Boomburst does damage to all adjacent Pokémon, including allies.

moonblast.name: Moonblast
moonblast.description: Moonblast does damage and has a 30% chance of lowering the target's Special Attack by one stage.

play-nice.name: Play Nice
play-nice.description: Play Nice lowers the target's Attack stat by one stage and bypasses accuracy checks to always hit, unless the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move such as Dig or Fly. It will hit the target even if it has used Protect, Detect, Spiky Shield, or Max Guard but will fail if the target is protected by Crafty Shield. Play Nice bypasses s.

water-shuriken.name: Water Shuriken
water-shuriken.description: Water Shuriken is a physical move in this generation.

diamond-storm.name: Diamond Storm
diamond-storm.description: Diamond Storm deals damage. It has a 50% chance to raise the user's Defense by one stage for each Pokémon that it hits. If it increases the user's Defense stat more than once from a single use, the stat-raising animation will play only once, but a message stating that its Defense rose will appear for each increase.

confide.name: Confide
confide.description: Confide lowers the target's Special Attack stat by one stage and bypasses accuracy checks to always hit, unless the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move (such as Dig or Fly). Confide can hit Pokémon even if they are behind a substitute. Confide will hit the target even if it has used Protect, Detect, or Spiky Shield, but will be blocked by Crafty Shield.

steam-eruption.name: Steam Eruption
steam-eruption.description: Steam Eruption deals damage and has a 30% chance of burning the target. Upon execution, Steam Eruption will thaw the user if frozen (even if the move fails to hit the target).

mystical-fire.name: Mystical Fire
mystical-fire.description: Mystical Fire inflicts damage and lowers the target's Special Attack stat by one stage.

hyperspace-hole.name: Hyperspace Hole
hyperspace-hole.description: Hyperspace Hole inflicts damage and bypasses accuracy checks to always hit, unless the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move such as Dig or Fly.

aromatic-mist.name: Aromatic Mist
aromatic-mist.description: Aromatic Mist raises the Special Defense stat of a target ally Pokémon by one stage. In a Battle Royal, where there are no allies, it can successfully be used targeting any opposing Pokémon.

spiky-shield.name: Spiky Shield
spiky-shield.description: Spiky Shield protects the user from all effects of moves that target it during the turn it is used, including damage. (This does not include damage at the end of a turn such as from weather or a status condition.) If Spiky Shield blocks an attack that would make contact with the user, the attacker suffers damage equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP. If a contact multistrike move is blocked by Spiky Shield, the resulting damage will only apply once. Moves that are blocked do not activate other effects that require making contact, like Rocky Helmet or Rough Skin.

eerie-impulse.name: Eerie Impulse
eerie-impulse.description: Eerie Impulse lowers the target's Special Attack stat by two stages.

venom-drench.name: Venom Drench
venom-drench.description: Venom Drench lowers the Attack, Special Attack, and Speed stats of all poisoned targets by one stage. If no targets are poisoned, the move will fail.

geomancy.name: Geomancy
geomancy.description: The user gains the Charging status on the turn Geomancy is selected. On the second turn, the user's Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed increase by two stages.

happy-hour.name: Happy Hour
happy-hour.description: Happy Hour doubles the amount of prize money earned at the end of battle (including from Pay Day and Make It Rain). It stacks with the Amulet Coin or Luck Incense, such that the prize money will be quadrupled if both are used. It can be stacked with the Prize Money O-Powers. It does not stack with itself.

magnetic-flux.name: Magnetic Flux
magnetic-flux.description: Magnetic Flux raises the Defense and Special Defense stats of allied Pokémon (including the user) with the Ability Plus or Minus by one stage each.

electric-terrain.name: Electric Terrain
electric-terrain.description: Electric Terrain creates terrain that envelops the field for five turns and replaces the background environment and any other terrain that is already in effect. It has the following effects on that are on the ground and not in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move: *It boosts the power of Electric-type moves used by affected Pokémon by 50% (regardless of whether the target of the move is affected by Electric Terrain), including moves that became Electric-type due to type-changing effects like Electrify and Galvanize. *It prevents affected Pokémon from being afflicted by sleep or Yawn. **If an affected Pokémon is already drowsy due to Yawn, it is prevented from falling asleep and the drowsy effect will end. **Rest will fail if used by an affected Pokémon. *Nature Power becomes Thunderbolt. *Secret Power uses the animation of Thunder Shock and has a 30% chance of causing paralysis. *Camouflage causes the user to become Electric-type.

dazzling-gleam.name: Dazzling Gleam
dazzling-gleam.description: Dazzling Gleam inflicts damage to all adjacent opponents.

celebrate.description: Celebrate has no effect in battle. When a Pokémon uses this move, it will disappear and a present will drop down from above and unfold to reveal the Pokémon that used it inside. The battle text will then display: Congratulations, <>!

hold-hands.name: Hold Hands
hold-hands.description: Hold Hands has no effect in battle. When a Pokémon uses this move in a Double Battle or Triple Battle, it and its target ally will perform a brief animation together.

baby-doll-eyes.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
baby-doll-eyes.description: Baby-Doll Eyes lowers the target's Attack stat by one stage. It has a priority of +1, so is used before all moves that do not have increased priority.

powder.name: Powder
powder.description: Powder covers the target in powder for the remainder of the turn. If a Pokémon affected by Powder attempts to use a Fire move, they take damage equal to 25% of their maximum HP and cannot execute the move (PP is still consumed).

hold-back.name: Hold Back
hold-back.description: Hold Back inflicts damage, but will leave the target with 1 HP if it would otherwise cause it to faint. If the target has 1 HP remaining, Hold Back will hit and leave the target at 1 HP.

infestation.name: Infestation
infestation.description: Infestation inflicts 1/8 of the target's maximum HP as damage per turn for four to five turns upon use, in addition to the damage dealt when it is used. It also traps the target, preventing switching and escape. The quote " has been afflicted with an infestation by !" will appear. If the user switches out, the target will be freed. If a trapped Pokémon uses Rapid Spin, it will be freed.

oblivion-wing.name: Oblivion Wing
oblivion-wing.description: Oblivion Wing inflicts damage on the target and restores the user's HP by 75% of the damage dealt. It can hit non-adjacent opponents in Triple Battles.

thousand-arrows.name: Thousand Arrows
thousand-arrows.description: Thousand Arrows inflicts damage. Despite being a Ground move, it can damage ungrounded Pokémon that are Flying, have Levitate or Eelevate, hold an Air Balloon, or are affected by Magnet Rise or Telekinesis; a Flying-type Pokémon not already grounded will receive neutral damage from Thousand Arrows, regardless of its secondary type, and the effects of Magnet Rise and Telekinesis will be removed.

origin-pulse.name: Origin Pulse
origin-pulse.description: Origin Pulse deals damage to all adjacent opponents. Its power is boosted by 50% when used by a Pokémon with the Ability Mega Launcher.

lands-wrath.name: Land’s Wrath
lands-wrath.description: The user gathers the energy of the land and focuses that power on opposing Pokémon to damage them.

light-of-ruin.name: Light of Ruin
light-of-ruin.description: Light of Ruin inflicts damage, and the user receives recoil damage equal to ½ of the damage done to the target.

thousand-waves.name: Thousand Waves
thousand-waves.description: Thousand Waves inflicts damage and prevents the target from fleeing or switching out as long as the user remains in battle. Ghost Pokémon cannot be trapped by this move. The trapping property of this move is not an additional effect.
