catastropika.description: Catastropika does damage and has no secondary effect.

shore-up.name: Shore Up
shore-up.description: Shore Up restores the user's current HP based on the weather in the battle. Outside of a , it restores ½ total HP, rounded down. During a sandstorm, it restores roughly ⅔ (a multiplier of 2732/4096) total HP, rounded down.

baneful-bunker.name: Baneful Bunker
baneful-bunker.description: Baneful Bunker protects the user from all effects of moves that target it during the turn it is used, including damage. (This does not include damage at the end of a turn such as from weather or a status condition.) If Baneful Bunker blocks an attack that would make contact with the user, the attacker becomes poisoned (unless they are immune). (Moves that are blocked do not activate other effects that require making contact, like Rocky Helmet or Rough Skin.)

spirit-shackle.name: Spirit Shackle
spirit-shackle.description: Spirit Shackle inflicts damage and prevents the target from fleeing or switching out as long as the user remains in battle. Wimp Out, Emergency Exit, the Red Card, the Shed Shell, and the Eject Button can bypass this effect.

floral-healing.name: Floral Healing
floral-healing.description: Floral Healing restores up to ½ of the target's maximum HP. If Grassy Terrain is in effect, Floral Healing will restore up to ⅔ of the target's maximum HP.

sparkling-aria.name: Sparkling Aria
sparkling-aria.description: Sparkling Aria inflicts damage to all adjacent Pokémon, including allies. If the target was burned, the burn is healed. Burned Pokémon are not healed of their burns if the move does not affect them.

ice-hammer.name: Ice Hammer
ice-hammer.description: Ice Hammer deals damage and lowers the user's Speed by one stage.

strength-sap.name: Strength Sap
strength-sap.description: Strength Sap lowers the target's Attack stat by one stage, and restores the user's HP by an amount equal to the target's effective Attack stat before Strength Sap was used (taking any stat stages into account).

high-horsepower.name: High Horsepower
high-horsepower.description: High Horsepower deals damage and has no secondary effect.

spotlight.name: Spotlight
spotlight.description: Spotlight causes the move's target to become the center of attention, forcing all attacks from the target's foes to target it instead of their intended target. This effect overrides any other forms of redirection, either through moves like Follow Me and Rage Powder, Abilities like Storm Drain and Lightning Rod, or Ally Switch. The effects of Spotlight cannot be passed with Baton Pass.

leafage.name: Leafage
leafage.description: Leafage inflicts damage and has no secondary effect.

solar-blade.name: Solar Blade
solar-blade.description: Solar Blade charges up sunlight on the first turn and then unleashes the power as an attack on the second.

laser-focus.name: Laser Focus
laser-focus.description: Laser Focus causes the user's move to result in a critical hit until the end of the next turn, unless that move's target has Battle Armor, Shell Armor, or is under the effect of Lucky Chant.

darkest-lariat.name: Darkest Lariat
darkest-lariat.description: Darkest Lariat inflicts damage, ignoring any changes to the target's Defense stat stages. It does not ignore changes to stats that do not use stat stages, such as Reflect, such as Fur Coat, or items such as Eviolite. It also does not ignore changes to the user's Attack or accuracy.

toxic-thread.name: Toxic Thread
toxic-thread.description: Toxic Thread poisons the target and lowers its Speed stat by one stage. Both effects are independent from each other; the target's Speed is still lowered even if it cannot be poisoned (such as if it is a Steel or it already has a status condition), and the target is still poisoned even if its Speed cannot be lowered (due to Clear Body or if the stat is already at -6 stages).

gear-up.name: Gear Up
gear-up.description: Gear Up raises the Attack and Special Attack stats of allied Pokémon (including the user) with the Ability Plus or Minus by one stage each.

pollen-puff.name: Pollen Puff
pollen-puff.description: Pollen Puff's effect varies depending on the target. If it targets an opponent, it deals damage. If it targets an ally, it restores up to 50% of the target's maximum HP. Pokémon with Bulletproof are immune to both effects of Pollen Puff. Telepathy blocks the healing effect of Pollen Puff if used by an ally.

anchor-shot.name: Anchor Shot
anchor-shot.description: Anchor Shot inflicts damage and prevents foes from fleeing or switching out as long as the user remains in battle. Wimp Out, Emergency Exit, the Red Card, the Shed Shell, and the Eject Button can bypass this effect.

psychic-terrain.name: Psychic Terrain
psychic-terrain.description: Psychic Terrain creates terrain that envelops the field for five turns and replaces the background environment and any other terrain that is already in effect. It has the following effects on that are on the ground and not in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move. *It boosts the power of Psychic-types moves used by affected Pokémon by 50% (regardless of whether the target of the move is affected by the terrain). *Affected Pokémon become immune to opponents' moves with increased priority (including moves boosted by Prankster, Gale Wings, or Triage). ** (except Perish Song, Flower Shield, and Rototiller) cannot be blocked by Psychic Terrain even if they become priority moves. *Nature Power becomes Psychic. *Secret Power uses the animation of Confusion and may lower its target's Speed. *Camouflage causes the user to become Psychic-type.

throat-chop.name: Throat Chop
throat-chop.description: Throat Chop inflicts damage and makes the target Throat Chopped, preventing it from using sound-based moves for two turns. If the Pokémon is already Throat Chopped, the remaining duration is not refreshed. No message is displayed when a Pokémon becomes afflicted by Throat Chop, nor when the effect ends.

fire-lash.name: Fire Lash
fire-lash.description: Fire Lash inflicts damage and lowers the target's Defense stat by one stage.

burn-up.name: Burn Up
burn-up.description: If used by a Fire Pokémon, Burn Up will thaw out the user if it is Freeze, and then inflict damage to the target and cause the user to lose its Fire type. Burn Up fails if the user is not Fire-type, making the move always fail after the first use until the Pokémon regains its Fire type (either by switching out, or other type changing effects such as through Protean or Reflect Type); Burn Up cannot thaw the user if the move would fail (due to the user not being Fire-type).

speed-swap.name: Speed Swap
speed-swap.description: Speed Swap exchanges the Speed stats of the user and the target. This move does not swap in-battle speed modifiers, such as Abilities and stat stages.

smart-strike.name: Smart Strike
smart-strike.description: Smart Strike inflicts damage and bypasses accuracy checks to always hit, unless the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move such as Dig or Fly.

power-trip.name: Power Trip
power-trip.description: Power Trip deals damage. It normally has a base power of 20, but gains 20 power for every increased stat stage the user has. Stats decreased below normal do not affect this move's base power.

revelation-dance.name: Revelation Dance
revelation-dance.description: Revelation Dance inflicts damage and has no secondary effect. The type of Revelation Dance always matches the user's primary type.

instruct.name: Instruct
instruct.description: Instruct causes the target to immediately repeat its most recent move, ignoring those called indirectly via Dancer or Magic Bounce. PP will be deducted from moves used in this manner, and damage dealt by moves used in this manner is considered for the purpose of Counter, Mirror Coat, and Metal Burst (even if the target did not select a move this turn). If the target hasn't yet made a move this turn (but has on a previous turn) when instructed to use its most recent move, it will repeat its move from the previous turn, then later on when its natural turn order comes up, it can use its newly selected move normally.

trop-kick.name: Trop Kick
trop-kick.description: Trop Kick deals damage and lowers the target's Attack stat by one stage.

lunge.name: Lunge
lunge.description: Lunge inflicts damage and lowers the target's Attack stat by one stage.

purify.name: Purify
purify.description: If the target has a non-volatile status condition, Purify cures it and then restores the user's HP by up to 50% of its own maximum HP. It has no effect if the target does not have a non-volatile status condition (even if it has the Ability Comatose).

beak-blast.name: Beak Blast
beak-blast.description: Beak Blast is a decreased priority move. The user charges up at the beginning of the turn, and then executes Beak Blast at -3 priority within the same turn. All who make contact with the user during the charging phase are burned.

core-enforcer.name: Core Enforcer
core-enforcer.description: Core Enforcer deals damage. If the target has already used a move or had a Bag item used on it by its Trainer in the same turn, Core Enforcer also suppresses the target's Ability while it remains in battle.

clanging-scales.name: Clanging Scales
clanging-scales.description: Clanging Scales inflicts damage and reduces the user's Defense by one stage.

brutal-swing.name: Brutal Swing
brutal-swing.description: Brutal Swing does damage to all adjacent Pokémon, including allies.

guardian-of-alola.name: Guardian of Alola
guardian-of-alola.description: Guardian of Alola deals damage equal to 75% of the target's remaining HP (rounded down, but no less than 1).

dragon-hammer.name: Dragon Hammer
dragon-hammer.description: Dragon Hammer deals damage and has no secondary effect.

sinister-arrow-raid.name: Sinister Arrow Raid
sinister-arrow-raid.description: Sinister Arrow Raid inflicts damage and has no secondary effect.

malicious-moonsault.name: Malicious Moonsault
malicious-moonsault.description: Malicious Moonsault inflicts damage. If the target has used Minimize, Malicious Moonsault deals double its regular damage.

soul-stealing-7-star-strike.name: Soul-Stealing 7-Star Strike
soul-stealing-7-star-strike.description: Soul-Stealing 7-Star Strike inflicts damage and has no secondary effect.

aurora-veil.name: Aurora Veil
aurora-veil.description: Aurora Veil reduces the damage done to the user by physical and special moves for five turns by half; in battles beside Single Battles, Aurora Veil protects the user and all allies, but only reduces damage by (roughly) a third rather than half (specifically, with a multiplier of 2732/4096). It does not reduce damage done by self-inflicted confusion damage, critical hits, or . Aurora Veil can only be used during or snow, but the effect remains even after hail or snow ends; Cloud Nine and Air Lock will cause Aurora Veil to fail even if it is hailing or snowing.

stoked-sparksurfer.name: Stoked Sparksurfer
stoked-sparksurfer.description: Stoked Sparksurfer inflicts damage and paralyzes the target.

oceanic-operetta.name: Oceanic Operetta
oceanic-operetta.description: Oceanic Operetta inflicts damage and has no secondary effect.

genesis-supernova.name: Genesis Supernova
genesis-supernova.description: Genesis Supernova deals damage and causes the battlefield to become Psychic Terrain for five turns.

extreme-evoboost.name: Extreme Evoboost
extreme-evoboost.description: Extreme Evoboost increases the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed stats by two stages each. Extreme Evoboost will be unable to increase a stat that is already at +6; if all stats are at +6, Extreme Evoboost can still be executed, but will be unable to increase any stat.

shell-trap.name: Shell Trap
shell-trap.description: Shell Trap is a decreased priority move. The user sets up a trap at the beginning of the turn, then if it gets hit by an opponent's physical move within the same turn, it will use Shell Trap immediately after that move. Otherwise, when the user's scheduled turn happens at -3 priority, Shell Trap will fail at that time.

psychic-fangs.name: Psychic Fangs
psychic-fangs.description: Psychic Fangs removes Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil from the target's side of the field, then inflicts damage. It will not remove Light Screen, Reflect, or Aurora Veil if Psychic Fangs misses or the target is immune to or from Psychic Fangs.

spectral-thief.name: Spectral Thief
spectral-thief.description: Spectral Thief deals damage. If successful, it also steals the target's positive stat stages (if any) immediately before dealing damage. Spectral Thief bypasses s, and can successfully steal stat boosts from the boss of a Max Raid Battle even if it currently has a shield up. If the target has an Ability such as Clear Body, White Smoke, or Hyper Cutter that normally prevents some or all of its stats from being lowered, Spectral Thief can still steal boosts in those stats.

stomping-tantrum.name: Stomping Tantrum
stomping-tantrum.description: Stomping Tantrum is a damage-dealing move. If, on the previous turn, the user's last move missed, failed, or was prevented from being used due to an effect such as paralysis, Stomping Tantrum's power is doubled from 75 to 150.

prismatic-laser.name: Prismatic Laser
prismatic-laser.description: Prismatic Laser inflicts damage and then forces the user to recharge during the next turn. The user does not have to recharge if this attack misses, or if the target is immune to or from the attack.

accelerock.name: Accelerock
accelerock.description: Accelerock inflicts damage. It has a priority of +1, so it is used before all moves that do not have increased priority.

shadow-bone.name: Shadow Bone
shadow-bone.description: Shadow Bone does damage and has a 20% chance of lowering the target's Defense stat by one stage.

moongeist-beam.name: Moongeist Beam
moongeist-beam.description: Moongeist Beam inflicts damage, ignoring all during the execution of that move. (Ignorable Abilities are most Abilities that could potentially negatively affect the success, damage, or effects of a move if possessed by the target of a move or its allies—such as Multiscale and Friend Guard.) However, it does not ignore Abilities if it is called by rather than directly used.

fleur-cannon.name: Fleur Cannon
fleur-cannon.description: Fleur Cannon deals damage and lowers the user's Special Attack by two stages.

sunsteel-strike.name: Sunsteel Strike
sunsteel-strike.description: Sunsteel Strike inflicts damage, ignoring all during the execution of that move. (Ignorable Abilities are most Abilities that could potentially negatively affect the success, damage, or effects of a move if possessed by the target of a move or its allies—such as Multiscale and Friend Guard.) However, it does not ignore Abilities if it is called by rather than directly used.

natures-madness.name: Nature’s Madness
natures-madness.description: The user hits the target with the force of nature. It halves the target’s HP.

multi-attack.name: Multi-Attack
multi-attack.description: Multi-Attack inflicts damage and has no secondary effect. The type of Multi-Attack depends on the type of memory held by the user, being Normal-type if there is no held memory.

tearful-look.name: Tearful Look
tearful-look.description: Tearful Look lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack stats by one stage each. It bypasses accuracy checks to always hit, unless the opponent is in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move such as Dig or Fly. Tearful Look will hit the target even if it has used Protect, Detect, Spiky Shield, or Baneful Bunker, but will be blocked by Crafty Shield.

zing-zap.name: Zing Zap
zing-zap.description: Zing Zap inflicts damage and has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

plasma-fists.name: Plasma Fists
plasma-fists.description: Plasma Fists inflicts damage. In the remainder of the current turn, all Normal moves will become Electric, including status moves. This includes Max Moves, which will turn into Max Lightning (or G-Max Volt Crash or G-Max Stun Shock for Gigantamax Pikachu and Gigantamax Toxtricity, respectively).

10-000-000-volt-thunderbolt.name: 10,000,000 Volt Thunderbolt
10-000-000-volt-thunderbolt.description: 10,000,000 Volt Thunderbolt deals damage and has a sharply increased critical hit ratio of +2 stages.

light-that-burns-the-sky.name: Light That Burns the Sky
light-that-burns-the-sky.description: Light That Burns the Sky compares the user's Attack and Special Attack stats, dealing damage to the target using the higher stat. If the user's Attack is greater than its Special Attack, the move will be a physical move; if its Special Attack is equal to or greater than its Attack, it will remain a special move.

photon-geyser.name: Photon Geyser
photon-geyser.description: Photon Geyser deals damage. If the user's Attack stat is higher than its Special Attack stat, Photon Geyser becomes a physical move, doing damage to the target's Defense stat; otherwise it is a special move, doing damage to the target's Special Defense stat.

liquidation.name: Liquidation
liquidation.description: Liquidation does damage and has a 20% chance of lowering the target's Defense stat by one stage.

searing-sunraze-smash.name: Searing Sunraze Smash
searing-sunraze-smash.description: Searing Sunraze Smash inflicts damage, ignoring all during the execution of that move. (Ignorable Abilities are most Abilities that could potentially negatively affect the success, damage, or effects of a move if possessed by the target of a move or its allies—such as Multiscale and Friend Guard.)

splintered-stormshards.name: Splintered Stormshards
splintered-stormshards.description: Splintered Stormshards inflicts damage and removes any terrain present on the battlefield.

menacing-moonraze-maelstrom.name: Menacing Moonraze Maelstrom
menacing-moonraze-maelstrom.description: Menacing Moonraze Maelstrom inflicts damage, ignoring all during the execution of that move. (Ignorable Abilities are most Abilities that could potentially negatively affect the success, damage, or effects of a move if possessed by the target of a move or its allies—such as Multiscale and Friend Guard.)

lets-snuggle-forever.name: Let’s Snuggle Forever
lets-snuggle-forever.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

clangorous-soulblaze.name: Clangorous Soulblaze
clangorous-soulblaze.description: Clangorous Soulblaze inflicts damage to all opposing Pokémon and increases the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed stats by one stage each.

mind-blown.name: Mind Blown
mind-blown.description: Mind Blown inflicts damage, and the user takes damage equal to half of its maximum HP rounded up (unless it has Magic Guard). Mind Blown cannot be used when a Pokémon with the Ability Damp is on the field.

zippy-zap.name: Zippy Zap
zippy-zap.description: Zippy Zap inflicts damage and will always result in a critical hit. It has a priority of +2, so it is used before all moves that do not have increased priority.

floaty-fall.name: Floaty Fall
floaty-fall.description: Floaty Fall deals damage and has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.

splishy-splash.name: Splishy Splash
splishy-splash.description: Splishy Splash deals damage and has a 30% chance of Paralysis the target.

pika-papow.name: Pika Papow
pika-papow.description: thumb|230px|left|Artwork of Pikachu using Pika Papow

buzzy-buzz.name: Buzzy Buzz
buzzy-buzz.description: Buzzy Buzz deals damage and paralysis its target when it hits.

bouncy-bubble.name: Bouncy Bubble
bouncy-bubble.description: Bouncy Bubble deals damage and restores the user's HP by a percentage of the damage dealt to the target.

sizzly-slide.name: Sizzly Slide
sizzly-slide.description: Sizzly Slide deals damage and burn its target when it hits.

glitzy-glow.name: Glitzy Glow
glitzy-glow.description: Glitzy Glow deals damage and sets up the effects of the move Light Screen on the user's side of the field.

sappy-seed.name: Sappy Seed
sappy-seed.description: Sappy Seed deals damage and plants a seed on the target.

max-guard.name: Max Guard
max-guard.description: Max Guard protects the user from moves for the rest of the turn. It offers greater protection than most other protection moves.

baddy-bad.name: Baddy Bad
baddy-bad.description: Baddy Bad deals damage and sets up the effects of the move Reflect on the user's side of the field.

sparkly-swirl.name: Sparkly Swirl
sparkly-swirl.description: Sparkly Swirl deals damage and cures the user, all Pokémon in the user's party, and the user's allies, of all non-volatile status conditions (sleep, poison, paralysis, freeze, and burn).

dynamax-cannon.name: Dynamax Cannon
dynamax-cannon.description: Dynamax Cannon deals damage. If the target is Dynamaxed or Gigantamaxed, its damage is doubled. The bonus does not apply to Eternatus, despite its similarities to a Gigantamaxed Pokémon.

freezy-frost.name: Freezy Frost
freezy-frost.description: Freezy Frost deals damage and resets the stat stages of all active Pokémon on the field to 0.

snipe-shot.name: Snipe Shot
snipe-shot.description: Snipe Shot deals damage and has an increased critical hit ratio. It is unaffected by moves and Ability effects that draw in moves, such as Follow Me and Storm Drain.

veevee-volley.name: Veevee Volley
veevee-volley.description: thumb|230px|left|Artwork of Eevee using Veevee Volley

double-iron-bash.name: Double Iron Bash
double-iron-bash.description: Double Iron Bash inflicts damage, hitting the target twice per use, and has a 30% chance of causing the target to flinch with each hit (for an overall 51% chance).

jaw-lock.name: Jaw Lock
jaw-lock.description: Jaw Lock inflicts damage. It also prevents the user and the target from fleeing or switching out (even if they are allies), unless either of them is already prevented, and until either Pokémon is removed from the field. Jaw Lock does not prevent a Pokémon from switching out with Wimp Out or Emergency Exit or due to Shed Shell, Eject Button, or Red Card.

no-retreat.name: No Retreat
no-retreat.description: No Retreat raises the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by one stage each. It also prevents the user from switching out or fleeing. If all these stats have already been raised 6 stages, No Retreat will fail.

stuff-cheeks.name: Stuff Cheeks
stuff-cheeks.description: The user eats its held Berry, and raises its Defense stat by two stages in addition to the effect that Berry might normally have. The user can successfully eat its Berry even in the presence of Unnerve or Magic Room.

tar-shot.name: Tar Shot
tar-shot.description: Tar Shot lowers the target's Speed stat by one stage and doubles the effectiveness of Fire moves used on the target. Tar Shot will not double the effectiveness of Fire-type moves used on a target that is already under the effect of Tar Shot (but may still lower its Speed). The increased vulnerability to Fire-type attacks does not affect a Pokémon that is stallized, however if a Pokémon already affected by the increased vulnerability Terastallizes, the effect will remain. If a Pokémon could avoid Fire-type damage via Wonder Guard, but then gets hit by Tar Shot, it will become vunerable to said moves

magic-powder.name: Magic Powder
magic-powder.description: Magic Powder changes the target's type to pure Psychic. The effect lasts as long as the target remains in battle; however, changing form, transforming, or stallizing overrides the effect.

teatime.name: Teatime
teatime.description: Teatime causes all Pokémon on the field to eat their held Berry. This move bypasses s.

max-flare.name: Max Flare
max-flare.description: Max Flare inflicts damage and creates harsh sunlight for 5 turns (8 if a Heat Rock is held). Its power and whether it is a special or physical move depends on the move it is based on.

fishious-rend.name: Fishious Rend
fishious-rend.description: Fishious Rend deals damage. If the user attacks before the target, or if the target switches in during the turn that Fishious Rend is used, its base power doubles to 170. Strong Jaw further increases power by 50%.

dragon-darts.name: Dragon Darts
dragon-darts.description: Dragon Darts is a multistrike move that deals damage twice.

octolock.name: Octolock
octolock.description: Octolock prevents the target from fleeing or switching out. At the end of each turn, the target's Defense and Special Defense are lowered by one stage each. If the user switches out, the effects wear off.

max-lightning.name: Max Lightning
max-lightning.description: Max Lightning inflicts damage and causes the battlefield to become Electric Terrain for 5 turns (8 if a Terrain Extender is held). Its power and whether it is a special or physical move depends on the move it is based on.

court-change.name: Court Change
court-change.description: Court Change causes any active battle effects to swap sides. This affects barriers like Reflect, multi-turn effects like Tailwind, and entry hazards like Spikes. Court Change does not cause any Pokémon afflicted with a volatile or non-volatile status condition to pass that condition to another Pokémon, nor does it transfer any Pokémon's stat changes to any other Pokémon. Court Change has no effect on effects that affect the entire field (like weather, terrain, or Trick Room). If used on an effect created by a G-Max Move, such as G-Max Volcalith, Court Change will successfully switch the passive effect so long as it only impacts one side of the field.

max-flutterby.name: Max Flutterby
max-flutterby.description: Max Flutterby inflicts damage and then decreases the target's and its ally's Special Attack by one stage. Its power and whether it is a special or physical move depends on the move it is based on.

bolt-beak.name: Bolt Beak
bolt-beak.description: Bolt Beak deals damage. If the user attacks before the target, or if the target switches in during the turn that Bolt Beak is used, its base power doubles to 170.

max-strike.name: Max Strike
max-strike.description: Max Strike does damage to a target and lowers the Speed of all opponents by one stage. Its power and whether it is a special or physical move depends on the move it is based on.

max-ooze.name: Max Ooze
max-ooze.description: Max Ooze inflicts damage and then raises the user's and its ally's Special Attack by one stage. Its power and whether it is a special or physical move depends on the move it is based on. Compared to the other Max Moves, it usually has less power.

max-knuckle.name: Max Knuckle
max-knuckle.description: Max Knuckle inflicts damage and increases the Attack of the user and its allies by one stage. Its power and whether it is a special or physical move depends on the move it is based on. Compared to other Max Moves, it usually has less power.

max-phantasm.name: Max Phantasm
max-phantasm.description: Max Phantasm inflicts damage and lowers the target's and its ally's Defense by one stage. Its power and whether it is a special or physical move depends on the move it is based on.

max-airstream.name: Max Airstream
max-airstream.description: Max Airstream inflicts damage and raises the user's and its ally's Speed by one stage. Its power and whether it is a special or physical move depends on the move it is based on.

max-mindstorm.name: Max Mindstorm
max-mindstorm.description: Max Mindstorm inflicts damage and causes the battlefield to become Psychic Terrain for 5 turns (8 if a Terrain Extender is held). Its power and whether it is a special or physical move depends on the move it is based on.

max-hailstorm.name: Max Hailstorm
max-hailstorm.description: Max Hailstorm inflicts damage and creates for 5 turns (8 if an Icy Rock is held). Its power and whether it is a special or physical move depends on the move it is based on.

max-starfall.name: Max Starfall
max-starfall.description: Max Starfall inflicts damage and causes the battlefield to become Misty Terrain for 5 turns (8 if a Terrain Extender is held). Its power and whether it is a special or physical move depends on the move it is based on.

max-quake.name: Max Quake
max-quake.description: Max Quake inflicts damage and raises the user's and its ally's Special Defense by one stage. Its power and whether it is a special or physical move depends on the move it is based on.

max-rockfall.name: Max Rockfall
max-rockfall.description: Max Rockfall inflicts damage and creates a for 5 turns (8 if a Smooth Rock is held). Its power and whether it is a special or physical move depends on the move it is based on.

max-wyrmwind.name: Max Wyrmwind
max-wyrmwind.description: Max Wyrmwind inflicts damage and lowers the target's and its ally's Attack by one stage. Its power and whether it is a special or physical move depends on the move it is based on.

max-geyser.name: Max Geyser
max-geyser.description: Max Geyser inflicts damage and creates rain for 5 turns (8 if a Damp Rock is held). Its power and whether it is a special or physical move depends on the move it is based on.

max-darkness.name: Max Darkness
max-darkness.description: Max Darkness inflicts damage and lowers the target's and its ally's Special Defense by one stage. Its power and whether it is a special or physical move depends on the move it is based on.

clangorous-soul.name: Clangorous Soul
clangorous-soul.description: Clangorous Soul raises the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense and Speed by one stage each, at the cost of 1/3 of its maximum HP.

max-steelspike.name: Max Steelspike
max-steelspike.description: Max Steelspike inflicts damage and raises the user's and its ally's Defense by one stage. Its power and whether it is a special or physical move depends on the move it is based on.

decorate.name: Decorate
decorate.description: Decorate raises the target's Attack and Special Attack stats by two stages each. Unlike most moves, it bypasses moves like Protect, Detect, and even Max Guard to affect the target but is blocked by Crafty Shield. It cannot affect a target that has a or in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move. It is not reflected by Magic Coat or Magic Bounce.

pyro-ball.name: Pyro Ball
pyro-ball.description: Pyro Ball will thaw out the user if it is frozen, and then inflict damage on the target. Pyro Ball also has a 10% chance of burning the target. It has no effect on Pokémon with the Bulletproof Ability.

snap-trap.name: Snap Trap
snap-trap.description: In addition to dealing damage, Snap Trap inflicts 1/8 of the target's maximum HP as damage per turn for four to five turns upon use. It also traps the target, preventing switching and escape. If the user switches out, the target will be freed.

drum-beating.name: Drum Beating
drum-beating.description: Drum Beating inflicts damage and lowers the target's Speed stat by one stage.

aura-wheel.name: Aura Wheel
aura-wheel.description: Aura Wheel inflicts damage and raises the user's Speed stat by one stage. Its type changes depending on Morpeko's current mode. * Electric in Full Belly Mode. * Dark in Hangry Mode.

max-overgrowth.name: Max Overgrowth
max-overgrowth.description: Max Overgrowth inflicts damage and causes the battlefield to become Grassy Terrain for 5 turns (8 if a Terrain Extender is held). Its power and whether it is a special or physical move depends on the move it is based on.

body-press.name: Body Press
body-press.description: Body Press inflicts damage, but it uses the user's Defense stat instead of its Attack stat to calculate damage.

behemoth-blade.name: Behemoth Blade
behemoth-blade.description: Behemoth Blade deals damage. If the target is Dynamaxed or Gigantamaxed, its damage is doubled. The bonus does not apply to Eternatus, despite its similarities to a Gigantamaxed Pokémon. If used by a Pokémon with Sharpness, its power is increased by 50%.

behemoth-bash.name: Behemoth Bash
behemoth-bash.description: Behemoth Bash deals damage. If the target is Dynamaxed or Gigantamaxed, its damage is doubled. The bonus does not apply to Eternatus, despite its similarities to a Gigantamaxed Pokémon.

breaking-swipe.name: Breaking Swipe
breaking-swipe.description: Breaking Swipe deals damage to all opponents. It lowers the Attack of all targets by one stage.

branch-poke.name: Branch Poke
branch-poke.description: Branch Poke deals damage and has no secondary effect.

overdrive.name: Overdrive
overdrive.description: Overdrive inflicts damage to all opponents.

apple-acid.name: Apple Acid
apple-acid.description: Apple Acid inflicts damage and lowers the target's Special Defense stat by one stage.

spirit-break.name: Spirit Break
spirit-break.description: Spirit Break inflicts damage and lowers the target's Special Attack stat by one stage.

meteor-assault.name: Meteor Assault
meteor-assault.description: Meteor Assault inflicts damage and then forces the user to recharge during the next turn.

life-dew.name: Life Dew
life-dew.description: Life Dew restores the HP of the user and its allies by 25% of their maximum HP. If an ally has Water Absorb, Storm Drain, or Dry Skin, it will activate and negate this move's effect on it.

grav-apple.name: Grav Apple
grav-apple.description: Grav Apple inflicts damage and lowers the target's Defense stat by one stage.

strange-steam.name: Strange Steam
strange-steam.description: Strange Steam deals damage and has a 20% chance of Confusion the target.

false-surrender.name: False Surrender
false-surrender.description: False Surrender inflicts damage and bypasses accuracy checks to always hit, unless the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move such as Dig or Fly.

steel-beam.name: Steel Beam
steel-beam.description: Steel Beam inflicts damage, and the user takes damage equal to half of its maximum HP rounded up (unless it has Magic Guard).

expanding-force.name: Expanding Force
expanding-force.description: Expanding Force inflicts damage. It normally targets a single Pokémon.

steel-roller.name: Steel Roller
steel-roller.description: Steel Roller deals damage and removes any active terrain. If no terrain is active upon the move's execution, it will fail.

obstruct.name: Obstruct
obstruct.description: Obstruct protects the user from all effects of physical and special moves that target it during the turn it is used. If Obstruct blocks an attack that would make contact with the user, the attacker's Defense stat is lowered by 2 stages. Obstruct causes the Defense stat to drop even if the user of Obstruct was immune to that contact move. (Moves that are blocked do not activate other effects that require making contact, like Rocky Helmet or Rough Skin.)

eternabeam.name: Eternabeam
eternabeam.description: Eternabeam inflicts damage and then forces the user to recharge during the next turn, unless the move fails due to missing, type immunity, or being blocked by a .

meteor-beam.name: Meteor Beam
meteor-beam.description: On the turn it is selected, Meteor Beam will raise the user's Special Attack by one stage, and gives the user the Charging status with the message "[User] is overflowing with space power!" being shown. On the following turn, Meteor Beam will do damage (factoring in the Special Attack boost), PP will be deducted from it, and it will count as the last move used. Once Meteor Beam is selected, the user won't be able to switch out until it is disrupted or fully executed.

shell-side-arm.name: Shell Side Arm
shell-side-arm.description: Shell Side Arm deals damage and has a 20% chance of poisoning the target.

scale-shot.name: Scale Shot
scale-shot.description: Scale Shot inflicts damage, hitting the target 2-5 times per use. If the user does not miss, the user's Speed is raised by one stage, while its Defense is lowered by one stage. Each strike made has an equal chance to be a critical hit.

grassy-glide.name: Grassy Glide
grassy-glide.description: Grassy Glide inflicts damage. If Grassy Terrain is in effect and the user is grounded upon its execution, this move's priority is increased by one.

misty-explosion.name: Misty Explosion
misty-explosion.description: Misty Explosion inflicts damage and causes the user to faint. Under Misty Terrain, if the user is on the ground, Misty Explosion's base power is raised by 1.5×, making it 150.

burning-jealousy.name: Burning Jealousy
burning-jealousy.description: Burning Jealousy inflicts damage to all adjacent opponents and will burn any opponent that has increased its stats during that turn. It ignores stat increases from Imposter when determining whether to burn an opponent.

rising-voltage.name: Rising Voltage
rising-voltage.description: Rising Voltage deals damage. If the target is affected by Electric Terrain upon the move's execution, Rising Voltage's base power is doubled to 140.

skitter-smack.name: Skitter Smack
skitter-smack.description: Skitter Smack inflicts damage and lowers the target's Special Attack stat by one stage.

terrain-pulse.name: Terrain Pulse
terrain-pulse.description: Terrain Pulse deals damage. When there is no terrain active, Terrain Pulse is a Normal move. If the user is grounded under any type of terrain, Terrain Pulse's power doubles to 100 (type power-ups from the terrain will be put into effect in addition to this boost).

poltergeist.name: Poltergeist
poltergeist.description: Poltergeist deals damage if the target is holding an item, after displaying the message "[target] is about to be attacked by its [item]!" If used when the target is not holding an item, the move fails.

lash-out.name: Lash Out
lash-out.description: Lash Out deals damage. If any of the user's stats were lowered during the turn this move is used, its base power is doubled to 150. Lash Out does not power up if stat stages are modified directly due to an effect such as Haze, Clear Smog, or Topsy-Turvy.

coaching.name: Coaching
coaching.description: Coaching boosts the Attack and Defense of all allies (but not the user or allies in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move) by one stage each. It bypasses all forms of protection to affect the allies, including Crafty Shield.

corrosive-gas.name: Corrosive Gas
corrosive-gas.description: Corrosive Gas removes the targets' held items for the rest of the battle (even if switched out). Held items removed by Corrosive Gas cannot be recovered by Recycle or Harvest.

flip-turn.name: Flip Turn
flip-turn.description: Flip Turn deals damage and then switches the user out.

scorching-sands.name: Scorching Sands
scorching-sands.description: Scorching Sands inflicts damage and has a 30% chance of burning the target.

dual-wingbeat.name: Dual Wingbeat
dual-wingbeat.description: Dual Wingbeat inflicts damage, hitting twice per use. Each strike has an equal chance to be a critical hit.

surging-strikes.name: Surging Strikes
surging-strikes.description: Surging Strikes inflicts damage, hitting its target three times per use. Each strike will always result in a critical hit if possible (i.e. unless the target has Battle Armor or Shell Armor).

triple-axel.name: Triple Axel
triple-axel.description: Triple Axel inflicts damage, hitting the target up to three times per use. Its base power will increase by 20 with each successive strike, so the first, second, and third strikes have powers of 20, 40, and 60, respectively. Each of Triple Axel's strikes has a separate accuracy check. If any strike fails, the move ends.

jungle-healing.name: Jungle Healing
jungle-healing.description: Jungle Healing restores the HP of the user and its allies by 25% of their maximum HP, and heals any non-volatile status conditions they may have.

freezing-glare.name: Freezing Glare
freezing-glare.description: Freezing Glare inflicts damage and has a 10% chance to freeze the target.

wicked-blow.name: Wicked Blow
wicked-blow.description: Wicked Blow inflicts damage and will always result in a critical hit if possible (i.e. unless the target has Battle Armor or Shell Armor).

thunder-cage.name: Thunder Cage
thunder-cage.description: In addition to dealing damage, Thunder Cage inflicts 1/8 of the target's maximum HP as damage per turn for four to five turns upon use. It also traps the target, preventing switching and escape. If the user switches out, the target will be freed.

dragon-energy.name: Dragon Energy
dragon-energy.description: Dragon Energy deals damage. It has 150 base power at maximum HP, but its base power decreases proportionally to the user's remaining HP.

fiery-wrath.name: Fiery Wrath
fiery-wrath.description: Fiery Wrath damages all opponents. It has a 20% chance to cause each target to flinch.

thunderous-kick.name: Thunderous Kick
thunderous-kick.description: Thunderous Kick inflicts damage and lowers the target's Defense stat.

glacial-lance.name: Glacial Lance
glacial-lance.description: Glacial Lance deals damage to all adjacent opponents.

eerie-spell.name: Eerie Spell
eerie-spell.description: Eerie Spell deals damage and causes 3 PP to be decreased from the last move the target used (if any) in the current battle. PP will not be deducted if the target faints from the move.

psyshield-bash.name: Psyshield Bash
psyshield-bash.description: Psyshield Bash inflicts damage and raises the user's defensive stats. It has a base power of 70.

power-shift.name: Power Shift
power-shift.description: Power Shift switches the user's Attack and Special Attack stats with its Defense and Special Defense stats, respectively.

dire-claw.name: Dire Claw
dire-claw.description: Dire Claw inflicts damage and has an increased critical-hit ratio. It has a 50% chance (80% chance in the strong style) to either poison the target, paralysis it, or make it drowsy.

stone-axe.name: Stone Axe
stone-axe.description: Stone Axe inflicts damage and has an increased critical-hit ratio. It also leaves the target with splinters for 4 turns (Strong Style), 2 turns (Agile Style), or 3 turns (otherwise).

mystical-power.name: Mystical Power
mystical-power.description: Mystical Power inflicts damage. If the sum of the user's current Attack and Sp. Atk stats is greater than or equal to the sum of its Defense and Sp. Def stats, the user's offensive stats will be raised after the move hits. Otherwise, its defensive stats will be raised.

raging-fury.name: Raging Fury
raging-fury.description: Raging Fury inflicts damage and the user becomes fixated on using this move until the battle ends, or until another move is chosen.

astral-barrage.name: Astral Barrage
astral-barrage.description: Astral Barrage deals damage to all adjacent opponents.

springtide-storm.name: Springtide Storm
springtide-storm.description: Springtide Storm inflicts damage. If used by Enamorus or a that Mimic the move, it has a chance of boosting user's offensive and defensive stats. In its , it has a chance of lowering the target's offensive and defensive stats.

wave-crash.name: Wave Crash
wave-crash.description: Wave Crash inflicts damage and the user receives recoil damage equal to 33% of the damage done to the target and raises the user's action speed.

pulverizing-pancake.name: Pulverizing Pancake
pulverizing-pancake.description: Pulverizing Pancake does damage and has no secondary effect.

mountain-gale.name: Mountain Gale
mountain-gale.description: Mountain Gale inflicts damage and lowers the user's action speed. It has a base power of 100.

chloroblast.name: Chloroblast
chloroblast.description: Chloroblast inflicts damage, and the user takes damage equal to half of its maximum HP rounded up. It also lowers the user's action speed.

victory-dance.name: Victory Dance
victory-dance.description: Victory Dance raises the user's offensive and defensive stats, in addition to giving a 50% boost to the damage dealt by the user's moves.

headlong-rush.name: Headlong Rush
headlong-rush.description: Headlong Rush inflicts damage and then lowers the user's defensive stats for three turns.

esper-wing.name: Esper Wing
esper-wing.description: Esper Wing inflicts damage and has an increased critical hit ratio. It also raises the user's action speed.

bitter-malice.name: Bitter Malice
bitter-malice.description: Bitter Malice inflicts damage and has a 30% chance (50% chance in the strong style) to leave the target with frostbite. The move's power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

infernal-parade.name: Infernal Parade
infernal-parade.description: Infernal Parade inflicts damage and has a 30% chance of leaving a burn. The move's power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

triple-arrows.name: Triple Arrows
triple-arrows.description: Triple Arrows inflicts damage. For three turns, it increases the user's critical hit ratio by two stages and decreases the target's defensive stats.

barb-barrage.name: Barb Barrage
barb-barrage.description: Barb Barrage deals damage and has a 30% chance to poison the target. Its power is doubled if the target is affected by a .

ceaseless-edge.name: Ceaseless Edge
ceaseless-edge.description: Ceaseless Edge inflicts damage and has an increased critical-hit ratio. It also leaves the target with splinters for 4 turns (Strong Style), 2 turns (Agile Style), or 3 turns (otherwise).

sandsear-storm.name: Sandsear Storm
sandsear-storm.description: Sandsear Storm inflicts damage and has a 30% chance of burning the target.

bleakwind-storm.name: Bleakwind Storm
bleakwind-storm.description: Bleakwind Storm inflicts damage and has a 30% chance (50% chance in the strong style) to leave the target with frostbite.

lunar-blessing.name: Lunar Blessing
lunar-blessing.description: Lunar Blessing heals the user of any status conditions and restores a variable quantity of the user's maximum HP. It also obscures the user, making attacks more likely to miss.

wildbolt-storm.name: Wildbolt Storm
wildbolt-storm.description: Wildbolt Storm inflicts damage and has a 30% chance of paralyzing the target.

take-heart.name: Take Heart
take-heart.description: Take Heart cures the user of all status conditions and raises its offensive and defensive stats for four turns.

shelter.name: Shelter
shelter.description: Shelter raises the user's defensive stats in addition to making opponents' moves less likely to hit the user.

tera-blast.name: Tera Blast
tera-blast.description: Tera Blast deals damage. If the user's Attack stat is higher than its Special Attack stat, Tera Blast becomes a physical move when stallized; otherwise, it remains a special move. For determining which stat is higher, stat stage-modifiers are taken into account, but other effects (e.g. held items such as a Choice Band, Abilities such as Huge Power, etc.) are not. This is determined when the move is performed (not when it is selected), so for example the move's category may change mid-turn if another Pokémon goes first and uses a move like Charm.

silk-trap.name: Silk Trap
silk-trap.description: Silk Trap protects the user from all effects of physical and special moves that target it during the turn it is used. If Silk Trap blocks an attack that would make contact with the user, the attacker's Speed stat is lowered by one stage. (Moves that are blocked do not activate other effects that require making contact, like Rocky Helmet or Rough Skin.)

axe-kick.name: Axe Kick
axe-kick.description: Axe Kick inflicts damage and has a 30% chance of Confusion the target. If it misses, the user takes crash damage equal to half of its maximum HP. The user will also take crash damage if this move is used on a protected target, or if the target is immune to this move.

order-up.name: Order Up
order-up.description: Order Up inflicts damage. If the user has a Tatsugiri in its mouth via the Commander Ability, the move's animation will change and the user will gain a stat boost based on Tatsugiri's form: *Curly Form increases Attack by one stage. *Droopy Form increases Defense by one stage. *Stretchy Form increases Speed by one stage.

last-respects.name: Last Respects
last-respects.description: Last Respects inflicts damage. Its base power, which starts at 50, is increased by an additional 50 each time a Pokémon in the user's party faints during a battle. Revived Pokémon who then faint again also count, with the base power capping at 5,050 after Pokémon faint 100 times in the same battle.

lumina-crash.name: Lumina Crash
lumina-crash.description: Lumina Crash inflicts damage and lowers the target's Special Defense by two stages.

population-bomb.name: Population Bomb
population-bomb.description: Population Bomb inflicts damage, hitting the target up to ten times per use. Each of Population Bomb's strikes has a separate accuracy check. If any strike fails, the move ends.

spicy-extract.name: Spicy Extract
spicy-extract.description: Spicy Extract raises the target's Attack and lowers the target's Defense, each by two stages. It bypasses accuracy checks to always hit, unless the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move such as Dig or Fly.

spin-out.name: Spin Out
spin-out.description: Spin Out inflicts damage and lowers the user's Speed by two stages.

ice-spinner.name: Ice Spinner
ice-spinner.description: Ice Spinner inflicts damage and removes any terrain present on the battlefield.

salt-cure.name: Salt Cure
salt-cure.description: Salt Cure inflicts 1/8 of the target's maximum HP as damage per turn in addition to the damage dealt when it is used. If a Steel and/or Water type is affected by Salt Cure, the amount of damage per turn is ¼ of its maximum HP.

triple-dive.name: Triple Dive
triple-dive.description: Triple Dive inflicts damage, hitting the target three times per use.

jet-punch.name: Jet Punch
jet-punch.description: Jet Punch inflicts damage. It has a priority of +1, so is used before all moves that do not have increased priority.

glaive-rush.name: Glaive Rush
glaive-rush.description: Glaive Rush inflicts damage. If the move hits, it gives the user the Wide Open status. This causes all moves (including OHKO moves) to deal double the damage (excluding ) and bypass accuracy and evasion checks to always hit. The Wide Open status disappears if a different move is used.

mortal-spin.name: Mortal Spin
mortal-spin.description: Mortal Spin inflicts damage and then removes any binding effects and Leech Seed from the user, as well as entry hazards from the user's side of the field (unless the user has fainted as a result of the move, such as from Rough Skin). It also leaves each target poisoned.

fillet-away.name: Fillet Away
fillet-away.description: Fillet Away deducts half of the user's maximum HP (rounded down) from its current HP and, in return, it raises the user's Attack, Special Attack, and Speed stats by two stages each.

doodle.name: Doodle
doodle.description: Doodle changes the Abilities of the user and any ally to the targeted Pokémon's Ability.

flower-trick.name: Flower Trick
flower-trick.description: Flower Trick inflicts damage and bypasses accuracy checks to always hit, unless the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move such as Dig or Fly. It will always result in a critical hit if possible (i.e. unless the target has Battle Armor or Shell Armor).

torch-song.name: Torch Song
torch-song.description: Torch Song is a sound-based move. It inflicts damage and raises the user's Special Attack by one stage. Torch Song can hit Pokémon even if they are behind a substitute.

kowtow-cleave.name: Kowtow Cleave
kowtow-cleave.description: Kowtow Cleave inflicts damage and bypasses accuracy checks to always hit, unless the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move such as Dig or Fly. If used by a Pokémon with Sharpness, its power is increased by 50%.

ruination.name: Ruination
ruination.description: Ruination deals damage equal to 50% of the opponent's remaining HP, rounded down. It always deals at least 1 HP of damage.

hydro-steam.name: Hydro Steam
hydro-steam.description: Hydro Steam inflicts damage. If used under harsh sunlight, it receives a 50% damage boost, unlike all other Water moves, which would receive a 50% damage reduction in harsh sunlight instead.

collision-course.name: Collision Course
collision-course.description: Collision Course inflicts damage. If the move is on the target, its damage is increased by roughly 33% (or more precisely, by a factor of 5461/4096).

aqua-step.name: Aqua Step
aqua-step.description: Aqua Step inflicts damage and raises the user's Speed by one stage if the move is successful.

psyblade.name: Psyblade
psyblade.description: Psyblade inflicts damage. If there is Electric Terrain on the field, its base power is increased to 120, whether or not the user is grounded. If used by a Pokémon with Sharpness, its power is increased by 50%.

electro-drift.name: Electro Drift
electro-drift.description: Electro Drift inflicts damage. If the move is on the target, its damage is increased by roughly 33% (or more precisely, by a factor of 5461/4096).

make-it-rain.name: Make It Rain
make-it-rain.description: Make It Rain inflicts damage and lowers the user's Special Attack stat by one stage. In a battle with multiple opponents, Make It Rain will target all adjacent opponents.

shed-tail.name: Shed Tail
shed-tail.description: Shed Tail creates a at the cost of half of the user's maximum HP (rounded up), then switches the user out. The created substitute has 1/4 of the user's maximum HP. The Pokémon that switches in will then have the substitute. If the user is holding a Berry that would trigger in response to Shed Tail (such as a Sitrus Berry), it eats its held Berry before switching out.

raging-bull.name: Raging Bull
raging-bull.description: Raging Bull removes Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil from the target's side of the field (even if it targets an ally), then inflicts damage. If the move fails to hit the target, the effects of the screens are not removed.

chilly-reception.name: Chilly Reception
chilly-reception.description: Chilly Reception creates snow on the battlefield and switches the user out. Snow instigated by this move lasts five turns (or eight turns if the user is holding an Icy Rock). The user will still switch out even if there is already snow on the field when the move is used. If there are no other teammates to switch to, it will only change the weather to snow.

tidy-up.name: Tidy Up
tidy-up.description: Tidy Up raises the user's Attack stat and Speed stat by one stage each. It also clears away s, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Sticky Web on both the user's and opponent's side of the field. The user's stats will still be raised even if there are no traps or substitutes to remove.

snowscape.name: Snowscape
snowscape.description: When Snowscape is used, a snowstorm will begin on the field. This effect will last for 5 turns. This clears any other type of weather, but will fail if there is already a snowstorm. However, it cannot override weather that occurs in the overworld.

pounce.name: Pounce
pounce.description: Pounce inflicts damage and lowers the target's Speed by one stage.

hyper-drill.name: Hyper Drill
hyper-drill.description: Hyper Drill inflicts damage. It bypasses the effects of Protect, Detect, Spiky Shield, King's Shield, Baneful Bunker, Silk Trap, and Burning Bulwark, but does not lift the effects of these moves.

double-shock.name: Double Shock
double-shock.description: If used by an Electric Pokémon, Double Shock will inflict damage to the target and cause the user to lose its Electric type. Double Shock fails if the user is not Electric-type, making the move always fail after the first use until the Pokémon regains its Electric type (either by switching out, or other type changing effects such as through Protean or Reflect Type).

comeuppance.name: Comeuppance
comeuppance.description: Comeuppance returns 1.5 times the damage dealt by the foe's last attack. Unlike Counter or Mirror Coat, Comeuppance does not require specifically physical or special damage sources and Comeuppance does not have decreased priority; if the user acts before it is hit by an opponent's damaging move, Comeuppance will fail. The move also fails if the user's is hit instead. In battles involving multiple Pokémon, Comeuppance will hit the last opponent that dealt damage to the user. Comeuppance cannot affect ally Pokémon. However, if the last Pokémon to hit the user faints before the user moves, the remaining enemy Pokémon will be hit instead, like with a regular single-target damaging move (using the damage taken from the move of the now-fainted Pokémon that had hit the user).

rage-fist.name: Rage Fist
rage-fist.description: Rage Fist inflicts damage. Its power increases by 50 each time the user is hit during the battle by a move that causes direct damage, up to a maximum of 350 (after 6 hits). This includes moves used by either allies or opponents and includes moves that do not actually deplete HP, such as those that activate a Disguise. However, the power of Rage Fist does not increase if the user attacks itself due to confusion, nor does it increase when the user's is struck. Each strike from a multistrike move counts as one hit. Transforming copies the target's hit counter.

trailblaze.name: Trailblaze
trailblaze.description: Trailblaze inflicts damage and raises the user's Speed by one stage.

chilling-water.name: Chilling Water
chilling-water.description: Chilling Water inflicts damage and lowers the target's Attack by one stage.

bitter-blade.name: Bitter Blade
bitter-blade.description: Bitter Blade inflicts damage, and it restores the user's HP by half of the damage dealt. If used by a Pokémon with Sharpness, its power is increased by 50%.

armor-cannon.name: Armor Cannon
armor-cannon.description: Armor Cannon deals damage and lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense stats by one stage each.

twin-beam.name: Twin Beam
twin-beam.description: Twin Beam inflicts damage, hitting twice per use. Each strike has an equal chance to be a critical hit.

aqua-cutter.name: Aqua Cutter
aqua-cutter.description: Aqua Cutter inflicts damage and has an increased critical hit ratio. If used by a Pokémon with Sharpness, its power is increased by 50%.

blazing-torque.name: Blazing Torque
blazing-torque.description: Blazing Torque inflicts damage and has a 30% chance of burning the target.

wicked-torque.name: Wicked Torque
wicked-torque.description: Wicked Torque inflicts damage and has a 10% chance of putting the target to sleep.

combat-torque.name: Combat Torque
combat-torque.description: Combat Torque inflicts damage and has a 30% chance of Paralysis the target.

noxious-torque.name: Noxious Torque
noxious-torque.description: Noxious Torque inflicts damage and has a 30% chance of Poison the target.

electro-shot.name: Electro Shot
electro-shot.description: On the turn it is selected, Electro Shot will raise the user's Special Attack stat by one stage, and gives the user the Charging status with the message "[User] absorbed electricity!" being shown. On the following turn, Electro Shot will do damage (factoring in the Special Attack boost), PP will be deducted from it, and it will count as the last move used. Once Electro Shot is selected, the user won't be able to switch out until it is disrupted or fully executed. Electro Shot will not need a turn to charge if used during rain. If Electro Shot charges up for a turn before it is used, it will not go off if Disable is used on it.

ivy-cudgel.name: Ivy Cudgel
ivy-cudgel.description: Ivy Cudgel deals damage and has an increased critical hit ratio. The move's type changes depending on Ogerpon's held mask: * Grass in Teal Mask Form. * Water in Wellspring Mask Form. * Fire in Hearthflame Mask Form. * Rock in Cornerstone Mask Form. If used by a Pokémon other than Ogerpon, Ivy Cudgel will always be a Grass-type move, even if that Pokémon holds one of the masks.

matcha-gotcha.name: Matcha Gotcha
matcha-gotcha.description: Matcha Gotcha deals damage and restores the user's HP equal to up to half of the damage dealt. It also has a 20% chance of burning targets.

syrup-bomb.name: Syrup Bomb
syrup-bomb.description: Syrup Bomb inflicts damage and lowers the target's Speed stat by one stage each turn, for the next three turns. It does not affect targets with Bulletproof. If the move's user leaves the field, the effect will end immediately. The game uses a unique animation when the target's Speed stat is lowered.

tera-starstorm.name: Tera Starstorm
tera-starstorm.description: Tera Starstorm inflicts damage. When used by Terapagos in its , Tera Starstorm becomes Stellar and targets both opponents in a Double Battle.

magical-torque.name: Magical Torque
magical-torque.description: Magical Torque inflicts damage and has a 30% chance of Confusion the target.

fickle-beam.name: Fickle Beam
fickle-beam.description: Fickle Beam inflicts damage. It has a 30% chance to have its power doubled to 160. Consequently, the average base power is 104.

burning-bulwark.name: Burning Bulwark
burning-bulwark.description: Burning Bulwark protects the user from all effects of physical and special moves that target it during the turn it is used. If the opposing uses a contact move, it becomes burned (unless it is immune to burns). Moves that are blocked do not activate other effects that require making contact, like Rocky Helmet or Rough Skin.

thunderclap.name: Thunderclap
thunderclap.description: Thunderclap has a priority of +1. If Thunderclap's target has selected a physical or special attack and has not yet had a chance to execute its move, Thunderclap will damage the target; otherwise, Thunderclap will fail. Thunderclap only depends on the move the target has selected, and is not affected by any consideration of whether the attack can actually be executed, such as status conditions like sleep or freeze or like Truant.

mighty-cleave.name: Mighty Cleave
mighty-cleave.description: Mighty Cleave inflicts damage. It bypasses the effects of Protect, Detect, Spiky Shield, King's Shield, Baneful Bunker, Silk Trap, and Burning Bulwark, but does not lift the effects of these moves.

hard-press.name: Hard Press
hard-press.description: Hard Press inflicts damage. Its power varies between 1 and 100, and is greater the more HP the target has: :Power = 100 \times \dfrac {CurrentHP_{target}}{MaxHP_{target}}

alluring-voice.name: Alluring Voice
alluring-voice.description: Alluring Voice inflicts damage. The move also Confusion the target if the target's stats were raised during the same turn before the execution of Alluring Voice.

tachyon-cutter.name: Tachyon Cutter
tachyon-cutter.description: Tachyon Cutter inflicts damage, hitting twice per use. Each strike has an equal chance to be a critical hit. It bypasses accuracy checks to always hit, unless the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move such as Dig or Fly.

blood-moon.name: Blood Moon
blood-moon.description: Blood Moon inflicts damage. The user cannot select Blood Moon in succession unless the move failed. If the player attempts to use Blood Moon twice in a row, they will be prevented from doing so, and will be allowed to select another move. Once another move is used, Blood Moon can be used again.

temper-flare.name: Temper Flare
temper-flare.description: Temper Flare is a damage-dealing move. If, on the previous turn, the user's last move missed, failed to affect each of its targets, or was prevented from being used due to an effect such as paralysis, Temper Flare's power is doubled from 75 to 150.

dragon-cheer.name: Dragon Cheer
dragon-cheer.description: Dragon Cheer increases the user's allies' critical-hit ratio by one stage. If the affected Pokémon are Dragon, their critical-hit ratio is increased by two stages instead. The effects of Dragon Cheer can be copied by Psych Up, Transform, Costar, Opportunist, and a Mirror Herb.

gigaton-hammer.name: Gigaton Hammer
gigaton-hammer.description: Gigaton Hammer inflicts damage. The user cannot select Gigaton Hammer in succession unless the move failed. If the player attempts to use Gigaton Hammer twice in a row, they will be prevented from doing so, and will be allowed to select another move. Once another move is used, Gigaton Hammer can be used again.

upper-hand.name: Upper Hand
upper-hand.description: Upper Hand has a priority of +3. If the target has selected a physical or special move with increased priority from +1 to +3 (including Upper Hand itself) and has not yet had a chance to execute its move, Upper Hand will strike first and cause the target to flinch; otherwise, Upper Hand will fail. It also works on that give priority to moves, such as Gale Wings.

malignant-chain.name: Malignant Chain
malignant-chain.description: Malignant Chain inflicts damage and has a 50% chance of Badly poisoned the target.

supercell-slam.name: Supercell Slam
supercell-slam.description: Supercell Slam deals damage. If the user misses, the user will take crash damage equal to half of the user's max HP, rounded down. If the target is immune to Supercell Slam by type or Ability (such as Volt Absorb) or is protected, the move counts as a miss.

psychic-noise.name: Psychic Noise
psychic-noise.description: Psychic Noise deals damage and prevents the target from recovering HP for two turns. During these two turns, if the target uses a move with a healing property, such as Recover or Drain Punch, it will fail.

g-max-vine-lash.name: G-Max Vine Lash
g-max-vine-lash.description: G-Max Vine Lash is exclusive to Gigantamax Venusaur. Damages the foes and continues to damage them for four turns.

g-max-wildfire.name: G-Max Wildfire

g-max-befuddle.name: G-Max Befuddle

g-max-cuddle.name: G-Max Cuddle

g-max-smite.name: G-Max Smite

g-max-finale.name: G-Max Finale

g-max-steelsurge.name: G-Max Steelsurge
g-max-steelsurge.description: G-Max Steelsurge is exclusive to Gigantamax Copperajah. Damages the foes and scatters sharp steel spikes.

g-max-depletion.name: G-Max Depletion
